tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /kye rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa'i rnam bshad zin bris 'jam dbyangs dgongs rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bud+dha rat+na nir+m+ma ṇa ya na mo/ rje btsun dam pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen gyi rnam par sprul pa gang gi zhabs la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /brtse ba chen pos rjes su bzung du gsol/ /sa bcu'i byang sems bud+dha rat+na yi/ /rnam par sprul pa khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon/ /rje btsun mus pa'i gsung rgyun zin bris kyi/ /rnam bshad 'jam dbyangs dgongs rgyan 'dir spel lo/ /'dir kyai rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi mngon par rtogs pa'i rnam par bshad pa la/ /sdom ni/ bka' srol rnam bzhi'i 'byung khungs nges byas te/ /dkyil 'khor grangs kyis bsgrub bya ngos bzung nas/ /sbyor dngos rgyas bsdus sgo nas sgrub byed bshad/ /lung rigs gnyis kyis gtso bo bsgrubs byas nas/ /de nyid mngon rtogs bcu bzhis rtogs pa bskyed/ /rnal 'byor rnam bcus nyams su len pa'i thabs/ /sbyang gzhi sbyong byed lam byed rnam bzhi yis/ /lam byed tshul 'di bir+wa'i man ngag yin/ /zhes paltar don tshan bdun las/ dang po/ bka' srol rnam bzhi'i 'byung khungs nges par bya ba ni/ rje sa skya pa chen po la bka' babs bzhugs pa'i kyai rdo rje'i bka' srol la/ gzhung 'grel la brten pa gsum/ man ngag la brten pa gcig ste bzhi las/ dang po ni/ rje btsun chen pos/ snying po don gyi kyai rdor ni/ /bir+wa'i rjes 'brang ḍom bhi'i bskor/ /yan lag med ces pad+ma'i bskor/ /dam tshig rdo rje nag po'i bskor/ /gtso che'i chos sna sum cu dgu /lam bskor dgu ni khyad par ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i dang po/ bla ma bir+wa pa'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i ḍom bhi he ru ka'i skor la/ slob dpon de nyid kyi bdag med ma'i bsgrub thabs bdud rtsi'i 'od/ rdzogs rims lhan cig skyes grub/

lam gyi yan lag tshogs kyi 'khor lo 'du ba bsgrags pa dang bcas pa/ de nyid bcu pa ste gzhung bzhi mdzad/ de'i slob ma a la la badz+ra gyis sku rdo rje lha dgu'i mngon par rtogs pa phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba mdzad/ de'i slob ma nags khrod pas gzhung mdzad pa med la/ de'i slob ma gar+bha ri pas/ sku rdo rje dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs dran pa gcig pa zhes bya ba mdzad/ de'i slob ma bsod snyoms pas/ bdag med ma dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs mdzad/ de'i slob ma mi thub zla bas smin byed la dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bzang po yongs bzung / grol byed la rigs lnga char gyi sgrub thabs ston pa gur rigs bsdus kyi mngon rtogs/ bye brag tu mi bskyod pa'i rigs can la kyai rdo rje yab kyi mngon rtogs yan lag drug pa/ yum bdag med ma'i mngon rtogs/ sgrub thabs gsum char la 'jug pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga rdzogs rim gtum mo'i 'grel chung gcig kyang yod ces rje btsun chen pos bshad la/ da lta yod pa'i gtum mo'i 'grel chung ni/ mi thub zla bas mdzad pa ma yin te/ de'i 'jug na rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rat+na shrī dzñā nas mdzad zer ba yod la/ de ni rje btsun ga ya dha ra'i gsang mtshan yin gsung ngo / /de thams cad kyi rgyab rten du/ bka' 'grel ku mu ti ste gzhung bdun mdzad do/ /de'i slob ma slob dpon dpa' bo rdo rjes/ dkyil chog bskyed rim/ rdzogs rim/ rab gnas/ sbyin bsreg ro bsreg tshogs 'khor/ gtor ma/ mchod pa'i cho ga ste dgu po re re la le'u re re byas nas/ thams cad phyogs gcig tu sdom pa rin chen 'bar ba zhes bya ba mdzad do/ /slob dpon des 'brog mi lo tsa ba la gdams/ des mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po la/ des mkhon sgyi chu ba shākya 'bar la/ des bla ma sa skya pa chen po la gdams so/ /gnyis pa bla ma yan lag med pa'i rdo rje'i rjes su 'brang ba pad+ma badz+ra gyi skor la/

grub chen pad+ma badz+ra gyis smin byed la dbang gi cho ga nas gling mar grags pa/ grol byed la bskyed rim sgrub thabs mtsho skyes/ rdzogs rim mar me'i rtse mo lta bu'i man ngag lam gyi yan lag tshogs 'khor dam tshig lnga pa/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga bstod pa nyi shu pa/ de thams cad kyi rgyab rten du rtsa rgyud kyi bka' 'grel pad+ma can rnams mdzad/ rje btsun gyis gleng gzhi'i 'grel pa/ rtsa'i mngon par rtogs pa che chung gnyis/ dur khrod kyi 'grel pa che chung gnyis/ brda'i 'grel pa/ rdo rje'i glu'i 'grel pa che chung gnyis te/ skabs kyi 'grel chung brgyad kyang 'di'i bka' srol du bgrang par mdzad do/ /grub chen des in+d+ra bhū ti la gdams so/ /des lcam lak+ṣ+mī la/ des nag po spyod pa la/ des bram ze dpal 'dzin la/ des gha ya dha ra la/ des 'brog mi la/ des se ston la/ des zhang dgon pa ba la/ des bla ma sa skya pa chen po la gdams so/ /gsum pa bla ma nag po pa dam tshig rdo rje'i rjes su 'brang ba nag po shān+ta bha drā'i skor la/ slob dpon des smin byed la/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gzhung 'grel/ bskyed rim la lha dgu'i sgrub thabs/ yab rkyang gi sgrub thabs/ yum rkyang gi sgrub thabs/ rdzogs rim gyis gzhung gcig kyang yod par rje btsun chen pos bshad kyang / da lta de'i dpe mi snang ngo / lam gyi yan lag la tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga sbyin bsreg ro bsreg rab gnas/ mchod rten gyi cho ga gshin gyi cho ga rnams dang / de dag gi rgyab rten du/ bka' 'grel rnal 'byor rin po che'i sbyor phreng zhes bya ba ste/ gzhung bcu gnyis mdzad do/ slob dpon des 'gos lo tsā ba la gdams/ des bla ma mnga' ris pa la/ des mkhon sgyi chu ba la/ des rje sa skya pa chen po la gdams so/ /des na gtso che'i chos sna sum cu dgu ni/ 'grel pa lugs la rin chen 'bar ba gcig tu byas nas/

chos sna bco lnga/ mtsho skyes lugs la/ skabs kyi 'grel chung brgyad dang bcas pas bco lnga/ nag po lugs la chos sna bcu gnyis ste/ bzhi bcu zhe gnyis las 'grel pa lugs kyi lhan cig skyes grub /mtsho skyes kyi bskyed rdzogs gnyis ste gsum ni/ lam bskor dgu ni khyad par ro zhes pa'i khongs su gtogs pas lhag ma so dgu la 'jog pa yin no/ /gnyis pa man ngag la brten pa la rnal 'byor dbang phyug nas sa skya pa chen po yan chad du snyan brgyud 'ba' zhig tu bzhugs la/ rje btsun gong ma rnams kyis/ phyi rabs snyan brgyud 'dzin par mi nus pas/ gdams ngag nyams kyi dogs nas yig char btab pa'i rkang grangs la/ gzhung 'chad pa'i chos sna'i rkang grangs dang / gsung ngag nyams su len pa'i chos sna'i rkang grangs gnyis/ dang po la/ rje btsun gyis dag ldan du/ tsho bzhir gsungs te/ rgyud spyi la dgos pa'i sdom/ rgyud so so la dgos pa'i sdom/ rdo rje theg pa spyi dang / bye brag 'di'i rnal 'byor la dgos pa'i sdom/ sbas pa'i brtul zhugs la dgos pa'i sdom mo/ /dang po ni/ rgyud sde'i dum bu rnam gzhag mngon rtogs dang / /stong mthun gnyis kyi don bsdus bstod pa gnyis/ /bdag med bstod pa'i rnam 'grel dang bcas pa/ /kun du dgos pa'i gzhung bdun 'thor mi bya/ /zhes pa ste/ de la rgyud sde'i dum bu ni/ rtsa rgyud kyi dum bu rnams tshul bzhi'i rim pa ltar du bsgrigs pa ste/ sa skya pa chen pos mdzad do/ /rnam gzhag ni/ tshul dang po gsum phyogs gcig tu ston pa rgyud sde spyi'i rnam gzhag ste/ rje btsun rtse mos mdzad do/ /mngon rtogs ni/ mngon par rtogs pa rin po che'i ljon shing ste/ rje btsun chen pos mdzad do/ /stong mthun gnyis kyi don bsdus ni/ snga ma gnyis kyi sa bcad de/ rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'o/ bstod pa gnyis ni yab kyi bstod pa daṇ+ḍa ka dang / yum lha mo bco lnga'i bstod pa gnyis te rje btsun chen pos mdzad do/

/bdag med bstod 'grel ni sa paṇa gyis mdzad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgyud don so so'i rnam 'grel bsdus don bcas/ /gang la gang dgos de de blang bya ste/ /de ltar bcu gsum legs par bltas byas na/ /rnam par phye ba'i rgyud gsum shes par 'gyur/ /zhes pa ste/ rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa dag ldan dang / de'i sa bcad gnyis/ gur gyi 'grel pa gur rgyan dang de'i sa bcad gnyis/ sam bu ṭa'i 'grel pa gnad kyi gsal byed dang / de'i sa bcad gnyis so/ /gang la gang dgos de de blang zhes pa ni/ rgyud gcig shes par 'dod na gnyis dang / gnyis shes par 'dod na bzhi dang / gsum shes par 'dod na drug char blang zhes pa'i don no/ /gsum pa rdo rje theg pa spyi dang / bye brag 'di'i rnal 'byor la dgos pa'i sdom ni/ smin byed ltung ba'i rnam gzhag sgrub thabs bzhi/ /rab gnas sbyin bsreg tshogs kyi cho gar bcas/ /rdo rje dril bu bgrang phreng dgang blugs dang / /tha ma'i cho ga mchod rten bsgrub pa ste/ /de ltar bcu bzhi dang po'i las can nas/ /brtsams ste gang zag kun gyis bzung bar bya/ /zhes pa ste de la smin byed ni/ dbang gi chu bo chen mo dang / mchog dbang gsum grol lam la brten nas bskur ba'o/ /ltung ba'i rnam gzhag ni rtsa ltung 'khrul spong ngo / /sgrub thabs bzhi ni/ yab kyi sgrub thabs yan lag bzhi drug gnyis dang / yum gyi sgrub thabs yan lag bzhi drug gnyis ste bzhi'o/ /rab gnas ni bzang po drug go /sbyin bsreg ni las bzhi'i sbyin sreg go /tshogs kyi cho ga ni tshim pa drug pa'o/ /rdo rje dril bu dang bgrang phreng yig cha logs na med kyang / sam bu ṭa'i 'grel par gsal bar thon pa'o/ /dgang blugs ni yig cha logs na med kyang / las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi nang du mdor bsdus pa 'byung ngo / /tha ma'i cho ga ni gzhan phan bdud rtsi 'od do/ /mchod rten sgrub pa'i yig cha logs na med kyang gur rgyan du cung zad 'byung ngo /

/bzhi pa sbas pa'i brtul zhugs la dgos pa'i sdom ni/ lus rgyan btung ba'i snod dang gzung bya'i rdzas/ /rol mo'i cho ga stan dang bgo ba'i gos/ /'di dag he ru ka dpal chas drug ste/ /rnam par phye na bcu bzhir 'gyur ba yin/ /zhes pa ste/ de la bcu bzhir 'gyur tshul ni/ lus rgyan la/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang / zhag gi zo ris dang / thal chen gyi tshom bu dang / khrag gi thig le ste bzhi/ btung ba'i snod ni thod pa ste gcig bzung bya'i rdzas la/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang gri gug gnyis/ rol mo'i cho ga la/ cang te'u dang / gsang ba'i rnge'u chung dang / dung chen gyi gling bu ste gsum/ stan la mi ro'i stan dang / stag lpags kyi stan gnyis/ gos la/ mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi dang / stag lpags kyi sham thabs gnyis su phye bas bcu bzhi'o/ /gnyis pa gsung ngag nyams su len pa'i chos sna'i rkang grangs ni/ rje btsun chen pos/ glegs bam dkar chag tu btab pa'i chos sna drug cu la 'jog go /'di dag gi brgyud pa la/ ring brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang / bir+wa pa/ nag po pa nas rim pa bzhin brgyud de/ zhang dgon pa ba/ des sa skya pa chen po la gdams so/ /nye brgyud la gnyis las/ dang po gzhung 'chad pa'i nye brgyud ni/ rje btsun chen pos/ bla med phyogs ni ris bsgyur mig bcas pa/ /rig byed kyis gsal lag pas me la bgo /de 'od kun gsal chu gter 'byung bar babs/ /blo ldan don 'di shes na smra bar gyis/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa gsung ngag gi nye brgyud ni/ rje btsun rtse mos/ ye shes zla ba dri med mig la shar/ /sde snod gsum gyis de nyid gsal bar byas/ /rgya mtsho'i nang na nor bu bzhin du mdzes/ /blo ldan rnams kyis rtogs kyi gzhan gyis min/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar shes par bya'o/ /de ltar bka' srol bzhi'i nang nas/ man ngag lugs kyi bskyed pa'i rim pa 'dir bshad par bya ba yin no/

/gnyis pa dkyil 'khor grangs kyis bsgrub bya ngos bzung ba ni/ 'o na man ngag lugs kyi bka' srol 'di la/ rgyud gsum nas gsungs pa'i bsgrub bya dkyil 'khor gyi grangs du zhig yod zhe na/ 'di la mchog sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / las rgyas pa'i lha'i grangs gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rtsa ba'i rgyud las he ru ka bzhi/ bdag med ma dang lnga/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dkyil 'khor dang drug gsungs so/ /gur las rigs rkyang gi dkyil 'khor dang / rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor gnyis/ phyi ma la rigs bsdus rgyas pa lha zhe lnga ma dang / bsdus pa lha nyer lnga ma gnyis 'byung ste/ gur le'u lnga par/ dkyil 'khor re re bsgom pa'am/ /yang na bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /brgyad brgyad dbus su gnas pa'am/ /yang na nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar/ /gang tshe dkyil 'khor bsdus pa yi/ /sgor ni lcags kyu zhags pa dang / /lcags sgrog de bzhin dril bu ni/ /'jug pa'i sgo srung dgod par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rigs bsdus gnyis la sgo ba bzhi bkod pa'i tshe/ lha zhe dgu ma dang / nyer dgu mar 'gyur ro/ /rigs rkyang dang / rigs bsdus rgyas bsdus gnyis te gsum char la/ gtso bo go 'pho ba'i gnad kyis dkyil 'khor lnga lngar 'gyur te/ gur las/ sangs rgyas mgon po gang nyid kyi/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su gang gyur pa/ /de nyid kyis ni dkyil 'khor brjod/ /snying pos yongs bzung dkyil 'khor ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ des na rgyud 'dir/ rigs rkyang gi dkyil 'khor lha dgu ma lnga/ rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor rgyas pa lnga/ bsdus pa lnga ste bco lnga/ bdag med ma lha bcu gsum ma dang / bco lnga ma gnyis te bcu bdun gsungs la/ he ru ka gsum la/ rgyud 'di nas dpa' bo gcig pa las dkyil 'khor dngos su ma gsungs kyang / rtsa rgyud kyi rig pas 'khor kha bskangs nas/ dkyil 'khor gsum bya ste/ de ltar na dkyil 'khor nyi shu tham pa 'byung ba yin no/

/de la bla ma'i man ngag gis drug cu rtsa gnyis su dbye ste/ mi bskyod pa la he ru ka bzhi yod pa bzhin/ rigs gzhan la yang he ru ka bzhi bzhi yod pas/ rigs rkyang gi dkyil 'khor nyi shu'o/ /rigs bsdus rgyas pa nyi shu/ bsdus pa nyi shu ste drug cu'o/ /de'i steng du sngar gyi bdag med ma gnyis bsnan pas drug cu rtsa gnyis su 'byung bar mngon rtogs ljon shing las bshad la/ gur rgyan du/ yang 'dir rigs bsdus pa la/ brgyad dang bzhi'i dbus na bzhugs pa yod pa bzhin du/ rigs rkyang la yang bzhi'i dbus na bzhugs pa dang / brgyad kyi dbus na bzhugs pa yod do/ /zhes sbyar na brgyad kyi dbus na bzhugs pa nyi shu tham pa yod pas na/ bzhi'i dbus na bzhugs pa'ang nyi shu thams pa 'byung bas/ dkyil 'khor brgyad bcu rtsa gnyis 'byung ba yin no/ /zhes bshad kyang 'gal ba med do zhes gsungs pas/ rigs rkyang rgyas pa nyi shu bsdus pa nyi shu/ rigs bsdus rgyas pa nyi shu/ bsdus pa nyi shu/ bdag med ma gnyis ste brgyad bcu rtsa gnyis su bshad do/ /saṃ bhu ṭi las/ he ru ka bzhi/ bdag med ma/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor/ drag po'i gdan can te brgyad dngos su gsungs la/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor la/ gtso bo go 'pho ba'i gnad kyis lngar 'gyur te/ saṃ bhu ṭi'i brtag pa bdun pa dngos las/ gang gis gang yang / lha'i 'khor lo'i dbus su bcug pa de'i mtshan nas bstan par gyur pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor ni mkhas pas bsngags so/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /'o na gtso bo du ma 'pho bas dkyil 'khor de bas mang bar 'gyur ro zhe na/ rigs lnga kho na go 'pho ba yin gyi/ yum bzhi man chad kyi dkyil 'khor la bkod pa'i lha rnams gtso bor gyur pa'i mchog sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor med de/ brtag pa bdun pa dngos las/ zhi ba dang / rgyas pa dang / dbang dang / mngon spyod kyi las rnams la 'khor lo'i bdag po rgyal mo rnam par bsgom par byed do/

/zhes gsungs so/ /'o na saṃ bhu ṭi'i bdag med ma'i skabs kyi rgyu rdo rje 'chang gi dkyil 'khor ci'i phyir mi bgrang zhe na/ de ni rdo rje dbyings kyi khongs su 'dus pas mi bgrang ngo zhes mngon rtogs ljon shing las gsung pa'i don ni rtsa rgyud las rgyu rdo rje 'chang gi dkyil 'khor dkyus logs su bgrang ba ni/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rtsa bshad kyi rgyud gsung ba po'i ston pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ rgyu rdo rje 'chang nyid yin pas logs su bgrang la/ sam bhu ṭa'i rgyud gsungs ba po'i ston pa'i dkyil 'khor dgos pa ni/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nyid yin pas/ de las logs su mi bgrang zhes pa'i don no/ /de ltar na rtsa rgyud las drug rdo rje gur las brgyad bcu rtsa gnyis/ saṃ bhu ṭi las bcu gnyis te thams cad dril bas rgyud gsum nas gsungs skabs 'dir bdag gi bla ma rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan pa'i gsung las don bsdu 'di ltar gsungs ste/ kyai rdo rje'i rgyud gsum nas mchog sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor brgya gsungs par bshad pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las drug kha sbyor las bcu gnyis/ rdo rje gur las rigs bsdus dkyil 'khor rgyas pa nyi shu dang / bsdus pa nyi shu/ rigs rkyang yang rgyas pa nyi shu dang / bsdus pa nyi shu ste brgyad bcu'i steng du bdag med ma gnyis mnan pas brgyad bcu rtsa gnyis su 'gyur bas/ de dag la ngos 'dzin pa yin no zhes gsungs so/ /gsung 'di ni ha cang rgyas pa dang bsdus pa'i skyon dang bral ba'i tshig gi zab mo'i don bde blag tu rtogs par 'gyur ba'i ngo 'tshar rmad du byung ba'i gsung yin no/ /pa'i mchog sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor brgya tham pa 'byung ba yin no/ /gnyis pa las rgyas pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor la/ rtsa rgyud las brgyad/ gur las nyer brgyad/ saṃ bhu ṭi las sum cu tham pa ste/

rgyud gsum nas gsungs pa'i las rgyas pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor drug bcu rtsa drug 'byung ba yin no/ /gsum pa sbyor dngos rgyas bsdus sgo nas sgrub byed bshad pa ni/ 'o na rgyud gsum nas gsungs pa'i mchog sgrub pa dang / las rgyas pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor 'di dag sgrub par byed pa'i mngon rtogs ji lta bu zhe na/ 'di la sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes rdzogs par byed pa lam gyi yan lag dang gsum/ dang po la/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag pa/ ye shes kyi tshogs bsag pa/ srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa dang gsum/ dang po la yang / bsdus pa tshad med bzhi bsgom pa tsam dang / de las rgyas pa tshogs zhing spyan drangs nas mchod pa bsnan pa dang / de las rgyas pa yan lag bdun pa bya ba dang / de las rgyas pa rigs lnga'i sdom bzung bsnan pa dang bzhi'o/ /de la yang sngon 'gro rgyas pa ni/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag rgyas pa gnyis po gang rung dang / ye shes kyi tshogs bsag dang / srung 'khor gsum ka bya ba'o/ /'bring ni srung 'khor mi bsgom par/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag rgyas pa gnyis po gang rung byas nas/ ye shes tshogs bsag la 'jug pa'o/ /bsdus pa ni/ bsod nams tshogs bsag tshad med bzhi tsam la bsdus nas/ ye shes tshogs bsag la 'jug pa'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ dang po la/ ting nge 'dzin gsum gyis 'ching ba/ yan lag drug gis 'ching ba/ bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhis 'ching ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ saṃ bhu ṭi dang / rdo rje rtse mo'i dgongs pa ste/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ dang por sbyor ba'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /rnal 'byor pas ni snyoms 'jug bya/ /de nas dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog /de nas yang ni las rgyal po/ /zhes gsungs pa'i gtso bo bskyed pa dang po sbyor ba/ 'khor gyi lha mo dbyung ba/ ye shes pa gzhug pa/ dbang bskur nas rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab pa/ mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba'i bar dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog

phra thig la sogs pa la slob pa ni las rgyal mchog go /gnyis pa yan lag drug gis 'ching ba ni/ rdo rje gur gyi dgongs pa ste/ gur las/ sangs rgyas gnas ni rdzogs pa dang / /kun tu bzang po'i rang bzhin dang / /rang gi lhag pa'i lha sgrub dang / /mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang la sogs/ /rnal 'byor yan lag drug tu 'dod/ /ces gsungs te/ de la/ sangs rgyas gnas ni rdzogs pa dang / /zhes pa ni gzhal yas khang bskyed pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi yan lag ste/ chos 'byung nas gdan bskyed pa'i bar ro/ /kun tu bzang po'i rang bzhin dang / /zhes pa ni rjes su chags pa rdo rje sems dpa'i yan lag ste/ rgyu rdo rje 'chang bskyed pa nas ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug gzhug bya ba'i bar ro/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lha sgrub dang / /zhes pa ni dbang bskur ba mi bskyod pa'i yan lag ste/ dbang lha spyan drangs ba nas/ dbang don la nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i bar ro/ /mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba ni dngos bstan de nyid do/ /sogs kyis rjes rdzogs par byed pa lam gyi yan lag bstan to/ /gsum pa ni/ gsang ba 'dus pa dang / rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis kyi dgongs pa ste/ brtag gnyis las/ dang po stong nyid byang chub sems/gnyis pa la ni sa bon bsdu/ /gsum pa la ni gzugs brnyan rdzogs/ /bzhi pa la ni yig 'bru 'god/ /zhes pa ste/ dang po stong nyid ces pas ye shes kyi tshogs bsag bstan/ byang chub sems zhes pas dam tshig pa bskyed pa bsnyen pa'i yan lag gnyis pa la ni sa bon bsdu/ /zhes pas skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlob pa'am/ skye mched byin gyis mi rlob par/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlob pa nyer sgrub kyi yan lag gsum pa la ni gzugs brnyan rdzogs/ /zhes pas ye shes pa gzhug pa sgrub pa'i yan lag bzhi pa la ni yig 'bru 'god/ /ces pas dbang bskur nas rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas btab pa'am/ dbang mi bskur bar dbu brgyan rang chas su bsam pa sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag bstan no/

/'o na bskyed chog 'di dag rgyud gsum nas gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor gang dang gang la sbyor zhe na/ saṃ bhu ṭa'i rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor lnga ni/ ting nge 'dzin gsum dang yan lag bzhis 'ching / gur rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor rnams/ ting nge 'dzin gsum/ yan lag drug yan lag bzhi/ gsum char gyis 'ching / rigs rkyang gi dkyil 'khor rnams dang / bdag med ma gnyis dang / rtsa rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor drug ni/ yan lag drug dang / yan lag bzhis 'ching / saṃ bhu ṭa'i mchog bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor lhag ma rnams dang / las rgyas pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor rnams ni/ yan lag bzhis 'ching zhing / de'i tshe mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba gsum sbyar ba ni/ lam gyi yan lag yin gyi dngos gzhir mi byed do/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi 'bring po ni/ bsnyen bsgrub yan lag bzhis bcings nas/ mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba sogs mi byed par bzlas pa la 'jug go /gsum pa dngos gzhi bsdus pa la gnyis las bsdus pa dang po ni/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa bsnyen pa'i yan lag skye mched byin gyis mi rlob par sku gzugs byin gyis rlob pa nyer sgrub kyi yan lag ye shes pa gzhug pa sgrub pa'i yan lag dbang mi bskur ba dbu rgyan rang chas can du bsam pa sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag go /bsdus pa gnyis pa ni/ dam tshig sems dpa' dbu rgyan rang chas can du bskyed nas bzlas pa la 'jug pa'o/ /gsum pa rjes rdzogs par byed pa lam gyi yan lag la/ bzlas pa/ spyod lam/ thun mtshams/ gtor ma/ kha zas/ nyal ba/ ldang ba'i rnal 'byor te bdun ni/ mchog sgrub pa dang las rgyas pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor thams cad la yod la/ mchog sgrub pa la khyad par du dag pa dran pa zhes bya ba yod do/ /bzhi pa lung rigs kyis gtso bo bsgrub pa la/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rtsa bshad gnyis kyi gtso bo bsgrub pa dang / thun mong pa'i bshad rgyud saṃ bhu ṭa'i gtso bo bsgrub pa gnyis/

dang po la phyag bcu drug pa yab yum gtso bor bsgrub pa dang / de las mi bskyod pa'i rigs bsgrub pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rgyud gnyis po 'di las ni/ snying po kyai rdo rje phyag bcu drug pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor gnyis gtso bo yin te rtsa rgyud las/ bdag med rnal 'byor ldan pa 'am/ /yang na he ru ka dpal brtson/ /gzhan pa'i sems kyis skad gcig kyang / /dngos grub 'dod pas mi gnas so/ /zhes dang / de'i don rnam bshad dag ldan las/ bdag ni gang zag gi bdag dang chos kyi bdag go /med pa ni des stong pa ste/ nga med na nga yir 'dzin pa yang med pas/ bdag gnyis kyis stong pa'o/ /de ni lta ba'am ye shes so/ /de'i rnam pa gang la yod pa ni/ bdag med rnal 'byor te/ le'u brgyad par bstan pa gang yin pa'o/ /yang na dpal he ru ka zhes bya ba/ shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te/ he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid/ ru ni tshogs dang bral ba ste/ ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o/ /zhes bya ba'o/ de'ang lta ba'am ye shes so/ /de'i rnam pa ni/ zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'o/ /gzhan pa'i sems kyis zhes bya ba ni/ bdag med gnyis dang / ye shes dang bral ba'i lha gzhan/ ku ru kul+le la sogs pa shes rab kyi rnal 'byor gzhan dang / phyag gnyis pa la sogs pa'i thabs kyi rnal 'byor gzhan la gnas par mi bya'o/ /ji ltar zhe na/ 'bras bu 'byung ba med pa'i phyir dang / dpal gyi 'os ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de la 'bras bu 'byung ba med pa ni/ spyir gsang sngags pa 'bras bu lam du byed pas/ rgyu 'dra bas 'bras bu 'dra ba bsgrub par byed pa las/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa yin la/ de rnam pa gzhan gyis thob par ga la 'gyur/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku de ltar bzhugs par cis shes snyam na/ chos kyi sku'i dbang du byas nas/

rnam pa gzhan dpal gyi 'os ma yin pa'i phyir te/ chos kyi sku ni stong pa dang snying rje gnyis su med pa yin la/ stong pa nyid ni phyag bcu drug dang / rtogs pa'i khyad par zhal brgyad du sprul la/ snying rje'i spyod pa ni bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi zhabs bzhir sprul to/ /de bas na rnam pa 'dir rigs so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'o na rgyu 'bras kyi he ru ka gnyis las gang gtso bo yin snyam na/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa gtso bo yin te/ dka' 'grel ku mud ti las/ de'ang dpal he ru ka ste/ zhal brgyad pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag bcu drug pa/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa/ kyai rdo rje zhes bya ba'i don to/ /'bras bu nyid 'byung ba med pa'i phyir dang / dpal gyi 'os ma yin pa'i phyir yang he ru ka gzhan bzlog go zhes gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa de las mi bskyod pa'i rigs gtso bor bsgrub pa ni/ 'o na rigs lnga'i nang nas gang gtso bo yin zhe na/ mi bskyod pa gtso bo yin te/ gur gyi dka' 'grel las 'dir sems gtso bo nyid du bstan pa'i phyir/ rigs bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo he badz+ra nyid yin par nye bar bstan mod kyi/ gzhan dag kyang dgag pa ni ma yin te/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa saṃ bhu ṭa'i gtso bo bsgrub pa ni/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nyid yin te/ de'i brtag pa bzhi pa dngos las/ de nas dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog /rdo rje dbyings dang 'dra bas na/ /rdo rje dbyings zhes brjod pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /lnga pa de nyid mngon rtogs bcu bzhis rtogs pa bskyed pa la/ rgyud las mngon par rtogs pa lngar bstan la/ de nyid gang zag gi gnas skabs kyi sgo nas bzhir bsdu ba/ rtsa bshad kyi bskyed chog gi sgo nas bcu bzhir phye ba/ khyad par gyi chos zhib tu bshad pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud phyi ma'i lnga par/ gzhung 'khrugs med du byas nas/

skad gcig gis bskyed pa dang / sa bon las bskyed pa gnyis gsungs/ rtsa rgyud dang po'i brgyad par/ yum gyi skabs su de yi steng du zla ba yin/ /zla ba'i steng du sa bon nyid/ /phyi nas bdud las rgyal bas mnan/ /gnyis 'dus pa las bde chen po/ /zhes ā li kā li la mi ltos pa'i mi mnyam sbyor dang / ā li zla ba'i gzugs kyis gnas/ /kā li'i gzugs kyis snang byed do/ /zla ba nyi ma 'dus pa las/ /dkar mo la sogs rab tu grags/ /zhes ā li kā li la ltos pa'i mi mnyam sbyor dang / ā li kā li mnyam sbyor ba/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nyid kyi gdan/ /yi ge las byung gong bu la/ /hūm̐ phaṭ rnam pa'ang 'dod mi bya/ /sems dpa'i gzugs brnyan las byung ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor bdag po rnam par bsgom/ /phyag mtshan zhal sogs gong ma bzhin/ /zla ba chu shel nor bu'i 'od/ /ces pa ā li la ltos pa'i mnyam sbyor te gsum gsungs pa bla ma'i man ngag gis/ yab la yang sbyar bas mngon par rtogs pa lnga'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pas/ bskyed pa'i rims pa bsgom pa'i gang zag gcig nyid la/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa'i bzhed pas/ nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba mtha' dag dang ldan pa'i gang zag tha ma'i tha ma/ tha ma/ 'bring / rab bzhir 'gyur la/ de la gang zag dang pos bsgom par bya ba'i mngon rtogs ni/ ā li kā li la ltos pa'i mi mnyam sbyor dang / mnyam sbyor gnyis te 'di gnyis ni bskyed chog shin tu rgyas pa yin no/ /de ltar thun bzhir bsgoms pas du ba la sogs pa'i rtags lnga po/ mnyam rjes gang rung la mthong bar 'gyur la/ de tsam na gang zag de gang zag gnyis par na 'phos pa yin no/ /gang zag gnyis pas bsgom par bya ba'i mngon rtogs ni/ ā li kā li la mi ltos pa'i mi mnyam sbyor te/ sngar gyi bskyed chog las ā li kā li phri ba'o/ /de ltar thun bzhir bsgoms pas sems cher brtan cing rlung sems kyi 'phro 'du 'phel ba'i stobs kyis/

bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi dus su/ lus la bde shas che/ ye shes kyi tshogs kyi dus su sems la stong shas che/ dngos gzhi'i skabs su bde stong zung du chud/ bar skabs su lha'i snang ba stong zhing 'gro/ rmi lam mngon shes dang 'dra ba 'byung / de tsam na gang zag de gang zag gsum par na 'phos pa yin no/ /gang zag gsum pas bsgom par bya ba'i mngon rtogs ni/ sa bon las bskyed pa ste/ sngar gyi bskyed chog las mngon byang yang phri ba'o/ /de ltar thun bzhir nyams su blangs pas/ lha'i snang bas rdzogs rim shas che/ skabs skabs su lha'i rnam pa mi gsal/ kyai rdor bsgoms kyang / bde mchog la sogs par snang ba du ma 'gyur zhing mthong ba yong / rigs drug gi grong khyer la sogs pa 'khrul snang sna tshogs kyang mthong / dkyil 'khor yang du sogs bzhin du yal nas 'gro ba 'byung / de tsam na gang zag de gang zag bzhi par na 'pho ba yin no/ /gang zag bzhi pa des bsgom par bya ba'i mngon rtogs ni/ skad gcig gis bskyed pa ste sngar gyi bskyed chog las sa bon yang phri ba'o/ /de ltar thun bzhir nyams su blang zhing / sems 'dzin pa'i man ngag la nan tan du byas pa'i stobs kyis 'khor ba rigs drug dang / myang 'das sprul sku'i zhing khams rnams kyang nyams kyi snang ba la mthong / ting nge 'dzin la mnyam rjes med/ lus dang sems la bde stong brtan par zung du chud/ de tsam na mkha' 'gro ma'i bar chad kyi rtsol ba mang du byung na/ brda bstan pas bzlog gal te brda dang brda'i lan shes shing / mkha' 'gro mtshan ldan gyis rang gzugs ston na/ de dang snyoms 'jug byas pas skad cig de nyid la bden pa mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa rtsa bshad kyi bskyed chog gi sgo nas bcu bzhir dbye ba ni/ skad cig gis bskyed pa dang / sa bon las bskyed pa la ni dbye ba med la/ mngon byang gi mngon par rtogs pa la gsum las/ rtsa rgyud kyi bskyed chog sbyar nas yan lag bzhi pa'i phyogs gsum dang /

bshad rgyud kyi bskyed chog sbyar nas/ yan lag drug pa'i phyogs gsum ste drug yan lag bzhi pa'i phyogs gsum la/'khor gyi lha mo thig le 'gros dang / sa bon 'gros gnyis gnyis/ drug pa'i phyogs gsum la/ 'khor gyi lha mo sa bon 'gros dang / lha mo 'gros gnyis gnyis te drug de ltar na mngon byang gi mngon par rtogs pa la bcu gnyis/ de'i steng du/ sngar gyis skad cig gis bskyed pa dang / sa bon las bskyed pa gnyis bstan pas bcu bzhi'o/ / skabs 'dir paṇa chen nyi zla seṅges dogs pa'i gnas kun mkhyen rin po cher zhus pa dang lan gnang ba'i tshul 'di ltar gnang ste/ mnyam sbyor gyi mngon byang lnga la nges chos bsgrigs pa 'di rnams kun tu yin na rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i 'grel bar lha nag po mchis shing / kyai rdor tsam la yin na gur rigs bsdus su phyag mtshan lnga bar du bsgom pa mchis la/ rtsa rgyud kho nar yin na dkyil 'khor brgya'i sgrub byed du tshul bcu bzhi mdzad pa ji ltar lags/ zhes pa'i lan ni/ dang po gnyis ltar ma yin zhing phyi ma ltar yin la/ de la yang he ru ka bzhi'i nang nas phyi ma kho na'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ de la yang 'grel pa lugs dang man ngag lugs gnyis yod pa las/ phyi ma kho na'i dbang du byas pa ste/ rtsa ba'i rgyud dang po'i brgyad pa dang / phyi ma'i lnga pa gnyis la rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi man ngag gi bshad pa nyid las tshul bcu bzhi 'byung zhing / de'i tshe nges ba'i chos 'di rnams 'grig dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /des na nges pa'i chos 'di rnams 'grig pa'i gzhi ngos zin na/ dogs pa rang grol du 'gyur ro/ /gur rigs bsdus kyi mnyam sbyor la phyag mtshan lnga bar du bsgom pa ni mi thub zla ba'i gzhung dang / gur rgyan gnyis las ma bshad do/ /de ltar na dkyil 'khor brgya'i sgrub byed du tshul bcu bzhi mdzad pa ji ltar lags zhes pa ni/ de'i sgrub byed du bkod pa kho bos sngar ma mthong zhing /

da lta yang 'brel ma go ste/ dkyil 'khor brgyar byed pa'i tshe rtsa rgyud las dkyil 'khor drug kho na 'byung la tshul bcu bzhi ma byas kyang / dkyil 'khor drug bgrang ba las gegs cung zad kyang med pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ bzhi pa khyad par gyi chos zhib tu bshad pa la/ 'ching byed yan lag gi khyad par/ gzhal yas khang bskyed tshul gyi khyad par/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa bskyed tshul gyi khyad par/ 'khor gyi lha mo spros tshul gyi khyad par/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'chang bzhengs tshul gyi khyad par dang lnga/ dang po ni/ skad cig gis bskyed pa dang / sa bon las bskyed pa gnyis ni/ 'ching byed yan lag bzhi kho nas 'ching ba yin te/ rtsa rgyud nas bshad pa'i bskyed chog yin pas 'ching byed kyang / de'i 'ching gis 'ching dgos pas so/ /mngon byang gi yan lag bzhi pa'i phyogs rnams kyang / 'ching byed yan lag bzhi kho nas 'ching pa yin te sgrub byed snga ma bzhin no/ /yan lag drug pa'i phyogs rnams ni/ 'ching byed yan lag drug kho nas 'ching pa yin te/ bshad rgyud rdo rje gur gyi bskyed chog yin pas 'ching byed kyang / de'i 'ching gis 'ching dgos pas so/ /gnyis pa gzhal yas khang bskyed tshul gyi khyad par ni/ skad gcig gis bskyed pa dang / sa bon las bskyed pa'i gzhal yas khang gnyis ka skad cig gis bskyed pa yin la/ mngon byang gi yan lag bzhi pa'i phyogs rnams la/ 'byung bzhi sa nas rim pa bzhin bskyed pa'i lugs bzlog la rang sems 'dres pa tsam las bskyed dgos te/ rtsa rgyud dang po'i brgyad pa las/ 'khor lo sngon du ci rigs par/ lha rnams ji ltar 'byung pa'o/ /zhes pa'i tshig rkang pa gnyis la/ tshig bcad 'og mas bsdus don man ngag gi bshad pa byed pa'i tshe/ 'khor lo sa dang / sngon ni chu/ ci rigs pa me/ lha rnams rlung / ji ltar 'byung ba rang sems la sbyar ba mtsho skyes lugs dang tshul mtshungs par mdzad pa'i phyir ro/

yan lag drug pa'i phyogs rnams la ni/ rlung nas rim pa bzhin du bsgoms pa'i 'byung bzhi lugs 'byung dang / de'i steng du bh+rūṃ las 'khor lo dang / de rnams la bar do'i mtshon byed yig 'bru lnga 'dres pa las gzhal yas khang bskyed dgos te/ bskyed chog 'di gur las gsal bar gsungs pa/ yan lag drug pa'i phyogs la sbyar ba mi thub zla ba dang tshul mtshungs par mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i tshe rtsa rgyud kyi tshig gong 'og rnams la yan lag gi don gyi bshad pa byed dgos pa ni gnad kyi don no/ /gsum pa ni skad cig gis bskyed pa dang / sa bon las bskyed pa gnyis kyi rgyu rdo rje 'chang ni nag po kho na ste/ 'di'i bskyed chog rtsa rgyud phyi ma'i lnga pa la brten pa yin la/ der rgyu rdo rje 'chang nag po kho nar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /yan lag bzhi pa'i phyogs kyi ā li kā li la ltos pa'i mi mnyam sbyor gnyis/ ma ltos pa'i mi mnyam sbyor gnyis ste/ bzhi po'i rgyu rdo rje 'chang yang nag po ste/ gtso 'khor thams cad mi mnyam sbyor gyi mngon byang las bskyed pa yin pas/ de'i tshe rgyu rdo rje 'chang nag po las gzhan mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /yan lag drug pa'i phyogs kyi ā li kā li la ltos pa'i mi mnyam sbyor gnyis/ ma ltos pa'i mi mnyam sbyor gnyis te/ bzhi po'i rgyu rdo rje 'chang ni dkar po ste/ 'di gur nas bshad pa'i mngon rtogs kyis 'ching dgos pas/ de las rgyu rdo rje 'chang dkar po las gzhan ma gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /mnyam sbyor gyi yan lag bzhi pa'i phyogs gnyis dang / drug pa'i phyogs gnyis te bzhi po'i rgyu rdo rje 'chang ni dkar po kho na ste/ mnyam sbyor las bskyed pa'i lha'i gtso bo ni dkar po kho nar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa ni yum gyi mkhar thig le brgyad du gyur pa'i bar ni thams cad la 'dra la/ skad cig gis bskyed pa la ni/

de rnams lha mo brgyad du gyur nas/ yum gyi mkha' nas phyir spros te/ shar du gau rī zhes sogs dang / sa bon las bskyed pa la ni yan lag drug pa ltar ro/ /mngon byang las bskyed pa la yan lag bzhi pa'i phyogs rnams la ni yum gyi mkhar thig le brgyad du gyur/ de rnams phyogs mtshams kyi nyi zla kha sbyor gyis bar du spros pas/ sa bon brgyad las phyag mtshan brgyad sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ de rnams ro gcig tu 'dres pa las bskyed pa'am/ yum gyi mkhar sa bon brgyad du gyur pa/ phyogs mtshams kyi nyi zla kha sbyor gyi bar du spros pa/ phyag mtshan la sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ de rnams ro gcig tu 'dres pa las bskyed pa gang rung ngo / /yan lag drug pa'i phyogs rnams la yum gyi mkhar thig le brgyad du gyur/ de rnams gam̐ tsam̐ la sogs pa'i sa bon brgyad du gyur/ de rnams lha mo brgyad du gyur nas so so'i gdan gyi steng du spros pa'am/ sa bon brgyad so so'i gdan gyi steng du spros nas/ shar du gam̐ las gau rī zhes sogs kyis bskyed pa gang rung ngo / /lnga pa ni skad cig gis bskyed pa'i phyogs la/ slar yang yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas yab yum gyi rtsa phran stong phrag bdun bcu rtsa gnyis bskul te/ phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched rnams 'od du zhu nas bdud bzhi'i steng du bde ba chen po'i ngo bo thig le sngo skya gcig tu gyur par bsams la nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i sngags brjod mi dgos/ sa bon las bskyed pa dang / mngon byang gi yan lag bzhi pa'i phyogs rnams la zhu ba 'di dang 'dra'o/ /glus bskul ba ni thams cad la 'dra la/ de nas skad cig gis bskyed pa la ni/ thig le de skad cig gis 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin par bskyed/ sa bon las bskyed pa la ni 'og yan lag drug pa ltar ro/ /mngon byang gi gtso bo mnyam sbyor dang / 'khor mi mnyam sbyor las bskyed pa dang /

gtso 'khor thams cad ā li kā li la ltos pa'i mi mnyam sbyor las bskyed pa rnams la/ thig le de cha gsum chad pa las/ 'og gi thig le ā li las zla ba/ steng gi thig le kā li las nyi ma/ bar gyi thig le sa bon las phyag mtshan sa bon gyis mtshan pa ro gcig tu 'dres pa las 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin par bskyed do/ /gtso 'khor thams cad la ā li kā li spangs pa'i mi mnyam sbyor las bskyed pa'i phyogs la thig le de cha gsum chad pa las/ 'og gi thig le zla ba/ steng gi thig le nyi ma/ bar gyi thig le man chad sngar dang 'dra'o/ /yan lag drug pa'i phyogs rnams la/ rgyu rdo rje 'chang yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas/ nam mkha' nas bar do mtshon byed kyi yi ge lnga zhal du zhugs/ yum gyi mkhar slebs pa'i rkyen gyis/ bdud bzhi'i steng du bde ba chen po'i ngo bo rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin gyi thig ler gyur par bsams la/ nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i sngags brjod/ de nas glus bskul rjes thig le hūm̐ aṃ sngon po 'bar zhing 'jigs par gyur/ de 'od du zhu ba las 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa bskyed do/ /'o na rje btsun gyis mngon par rtogs pa bcu bzhi'am bco lngar snang mod kyi/ rgyud 'di nyid kyi steng du rtogs par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i bco lnga pa gang yin snyam na/ rnam bshad dag ldan du/ 'khrugs can gyi mngon par rtogs pa gsungs pa'i rjes thogs su/ 'di ni slob dpon mi thub zla ba'i dgongs pa gtso bo gzhung 'khrugs su bsdebs ste/ thun mong du gsungs ba tsam yin no/ /da ni 'dir rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po'i gdams ngag rje bla mas sbas te gsungs ba brtse ba'i bsam pas bri bar bya'o/ /de la 'dir 'khrugs med par le'u brgyad pa dang bsdebs te brjod na/ zhes sogs kyis tshul bcu bzhi po gsungs la/ de'i don slob dpon mi thub zla ba'i dgongs pas/

'khrugs can gyi mngon par rtogs pa kho na yin la/ man ngag lugs la yang / rgyud las bstan tshul gyis dbang du byas na/ snga ma bzhin bzhed pas gnyis ka'i thun mong du gsungs pa tsam yin no/ /zhes pa'i don no/ /man ngag lugs la thun mong ma yin pa'i gzhung 'khrugs med kyi mngon par rtogs pa tshul bcu bzhi gsungs la/ des na 'khrugs can gyi yan lag drug pa dang / 'khrugs med kyi yan lag bzhi pa gnyis nyams len la khyad med pas/ nyams su len tshul gyi dbang du byas nas mngon par rtogs pa bcu bzhir 'dus zhing / rgyud las bstan tshul gyi dbang du byas na/ man ngag lugs la yang 'khrugs can gyi mngon par rtogs pa gcig bzhed pas bco lnga pa'o/ /zhes pa man ngag lugs kyi 'chad tshul lo/ /drug pa rnal 'byor rnam bcus nyams su len tshul ni/ 'o na mngon par rtogs pa tshul bcu bzhi po de/ nyin zhag phrugs gcig la nyams su len tshul ji ltar zhe na/ 'di 'chad pa la/ de la kye yi rdo rje yi/ /rnal 'byor rnam pa gnyis yin te/ /mnyam par gzhag pa'i rnal 'byor dang / /mnyam par ma gzhag rnal 'byor ro/ /mnyam gzhag bskyed rdzogs gnyis yin te/ /ma gzhag nyal dang ldang dang khrus/ /mchod gtor bzlas dang kha bzas dang / /spyod lam rjes chags rnal 'byor brgyad/ /ces gsungs pa ni/ gzhung 'chad pa'i go rim yin la/ nyams su len pa'i go rim ni/ dang por nyal ba'i rnal 'byor/ de nas ldang ba'i rnal 'byor/ de nas khrus kyi rnal 'byor/ de nas mchod gtor gyi rnal 'byor dang bzhi sngon du btang nas/ mnyam gzhag bskyed rdzogs gnyis la 'jug de nas bzlas pa sogs phyi ma bzhi la 'jug pa yin no/ /de'i dang po nyal ba'i rnal 'byor la lugs gnyis te/ rang bzhin lhan skyes stong pa'i ngang la nyal ba dang / zhu bde lhan skyes bde ba'i ngang la nyal ba'o/ /dang po ni/ srod thun gyi mjug tu khams gsum snod bcud srung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/

de dur khrod brgyad la/ de gzhal yas khang la/ de lha mo brgyad la/ de zhal brgyad la/ yum yab la/ de snying kha'i hūm̐ la/ de'i zhabs kyu khog pa la/ khog pa mgo bo la/ de zla tshes la/ de thig le la/ de nā da la/ de'ang mi dmigs te stong pa nyid kyi ngang la nyal lo/ /gnyis pa ni/ srod mthun gyi mjug tu khams gsum snod bcud bsrung ba'i 'khor lo la bsdu/ srung 'khor mi bsdu par bzhag dur khrod brgyad gzhal yas khang la/ de lha mo brgyad la/ de zhal brgyad la bsdus nas/ rang kyai rdo rje yab yum tsam du gnas pa'i tshe yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas/ rtsa phran stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis bskul bas/ gtum mo rjes chags kyi mes/ phung khams skye mched thams cad 'od du zhu nas byang chub kyi sems kyi thig ler gyur pa'i ngang la nyal lo/ /de'ang bde shas che na rang bzhin lhan skyes stong pa'i ngang la nyal bas zung 'jug tu 'gyur la/ stong shas che na zhu bde lhan skyes bde ba'i ngang la nyal bas zung 'jug tu 'gyur ro/ /de ltar nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyi dgos pa ni/ tha mal gyi gnyid kyis mi brdzi ba dang / chos sku'i ngo bo lhan skyes ngo 'phrod pa'i dgos pa'o/ /gnyis pa ldang ba'i rnal 'byor la gnyis las/ dang po/ rang bzhin lhan skyes stong pa'i ngang la nyal ba ldang ba ni/ tho rang gnyid sad pa na/ skad cig gis kyai rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa'i skur ldang ba yin no/ /gnyis pa zhu bde lhan skyes bde ba'i ngang la ldang ba ni/ tho rang gnyid sad pa na/ rang bzhin gnas nas puk+ka sī sogs mtshams kyi lha mo bzhis/ rje btsun snying rje'i yid bzhengs shig /zhes sogs kyis bskul bas/ yan lag drug pa ltar na/ thig le de/ hūm̐ dang / am̐ sngon po 'od 'bar zhing 'jigs par gyur/ de zhu ba las/ bdag nyid 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin par bskyed nas ldang / yan lag bzhi pa ltar na/ thig le de cha gsum du gyur pa las mi mnyam sbyor gyi mngon byang las/

rang nyid 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin par bskyed nas ldang ba yin no/ /de gnyis char gyi mjug tu rdo rje'i glu/ bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad/ smon lam rnams byas nas skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs te/ des srod thun gyi mjug rdzogs so/ /de ltar ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyi dgos pa ni/ tha mal gyi rnam rtog las blo bzlog pa dang / bar chad kyi bgegs las bsrungs ba dang / lha yis lha la mchod pas tshogs myur du rdzogs pa'i dgos pa gsum yod do/ /gsum pa khrus kyi rnal 'byor ni/ skabs 'di'am gzhan du'ang rung ste/ khrus byed pa'i tshe/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga zhes sogs spyan drangs nas/ dkar mo ri dgas kyis mchod/ khyod ni sogs kyis bstod/ bcom ldan sogs kyis gsol ba gdab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyis/ /zhes sogs gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bar bsam/ dngos su rang gis yi ge brgya pa 'don zhing khrus bya'o/ /de ltar khrus kyi rnal 'byor gyi dgos pa ni/ thun mtshams kyi nyes pa phra mo 'dag pa dang / bsam gtan gyi grogs su 'gro ba'i dgos pa gnyis yod do/ /lnga pa bskyed pa'i rim pa la/ sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis/ dang po la thun mong pa'i sngon 'gro gsum kha bskang ba dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ bla chen 'phags pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas gsum skabs 'dir gsal bar bshad pa ni/ sngon gyi gdams ngag ji lta ba bzhin bris par snang bas shin tu legs pa yin la/ 'di la sngon 'gro gsum bya dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas/ sdom gsum cho gar mi ldan par/ /sngags pa'i bdag nyid mi 'gyur te/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sgrub pa po'i brgyud sdom pa gsum dang mi ldan par/

skyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor bsgoms kyang ye shes khyad par can mi skye bas/ rgyud sdom pa gsum dang ldan pa ni mi dgos kha med kyi gzhi chen po yin no/ /de yang sdom pa gsum gyi nyes pa chen po rnams 'dag par byed pa la/ sdom pa slar blang ba dang / bshags pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas sbyang dgos la/ nyes pa phra mo rnams 'dag par byed pa la sngon 'gro 'di gsum bya ste/ slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas/ dang por skyabs 'gro nas brtsams ste/ /sdom gsum cho gar rab tu brtag /de ltar sngags pas tshul ldan pa/ /dngos grub la ni dogs med de/ /ston pa sangs rgyas sogs mchod cing / /lha sogs 'jig rten kun gyis bkur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar du/ so thar gyi sdom pa yar ldan du bya ba'i phyir du skyabs su 'gro ba'i rnal 'byor/ byang sems kyi sdom pa 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir du sems bskyed kyi rnal 'byor/ sngags kyi sdom pa'i nyes pa phra mo rnams 'dag cing / chen po rnams stobs nyams zhing zil gyis gnon par bya ba'i phyir du/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas dang gsum/ dang po la/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar kyai rdo rje lha dgu gsal bar dmigs la/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa sangs rgyas dkon mchog gtso bo'i rgyab bai ta lī'i mdun du dam chos po ti brag ri brtsegs pa lta bu ni chos dkon mchog 'khor gyi lha mo ni dge 'dun dkon mchog skyabs su 'gro mkhan gyi gang zag ni/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad do/ /skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul ni/ bdag dang zhes pa nas phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku rnam par snang mdzad/ gsung 'od dpag med/ thugs mi bskyod pa/ yon tan rin chen 'byung ldan/ 'phrin las don yod grub pa ste rigs lnga'i ngo bo sangs rgyas kun 'dus/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas ni chos dkon mchog

'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag ni dge 'dun dkon mchog ste/ dkon mchog gsum po 'dus pa'i ngo bo/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes brjod pa'i tshe gtso bo dang bla ma tha mi dad pa la dmigs pa gtad/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes brjod pa'i tshe yang de ka la dmigs pa gtad/ dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes brjod pa'i tshe dam chos po ti la dmigs pa gtad/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes brjod pa'i tshe 'khor gyi lha mo la dmigs pa gtad do/ /de ltar skyabs 'gro ci nus byas nas/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing zhes pa nas/ byin gyis rlobs tu gsol zhes gsol ba btab pa'i rkyen gyis/ 'khor gyi lha mo rnams 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par byon nas rang gi dpral ba nas zhugs/ dam chos po ti 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par zhu nas rang gi mgrin pa nas zhugs/ gtso bo dang bla ma tha mi dad par 'od zer sngon po'i rnam par zhu nas rang gi snying khar zhugs pas/ dkon mchog gsum dang / rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med ro gcig tu 'dres nas/ bde stong zung 'jug gi ngang la cung zad mnyam par bzhag go /gnyis pa sems bskyed pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad bdag gi pha mar ma gyur pa gcig kyang med/ pha ma nam byas res kyis phan btags pa'i drin can sha stag yin pas sdug bsngal gyi gzir ba rnams snying re rje snyam du sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rjes kun nas blangs te/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bya'o zhes pa lan gsum bya'o/ /gsum pa skabs 'dir mtsho byed chos skyong dpal bzang pas/ chos rje glo bo mkhan chen par dogs gcod dri ba zhus pa dang /

lan gnang ba'i tshul 'di ltar snang ste/ mngon par rtogs pa nyams len gyi skabs su rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor du bya dgos rgyu yin pa la sngon 'gror sbyar ba don dang ji ltar mthun/ zhes pa'i lan ni/ spyir rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas dang dam tshig rdo rje'i sgom bzlas la sogs pa thun mtshams su nyes pa sbyong ba dang / khams gso ba la bya bar bshad pa mang du yod pas de dag tu bsgrub kyang chog mod kyi/ 'on kyang mngon par rtogs pa'i dngos gzhi thun gcig la yang sdom gsum gyi nyes ltung sor chud pa'i nyams len re sbyor ba la sngon du 'gro bar byas te 'jug pa'i dbang du byas nas kyai rdo rje'i mngon rtogs kho na ma yin pa'i/ bla med kyi nyams len gang gi sngon du'ang / skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdor sems bsgom/ /gsum ni spyi yi sngon 'gro yin/ zhes pa'i tshig 'di la legs par dpyad na/ rje btsun gong ma'i mngon rtogs rnams na rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas sngon du ma sgrigs pa dang / bla ma phyi ma rnams kyis sgrigs pa'i don la sgro 'dogs chod par 'gyur snyam legs shing / mnyam rjes kyi rnal 'byor so sor phye ste 'chad pa'i skabs su thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor du 'dus kyang / nyams su len pa'i tshe mnyam bzhag gi khongs su blangs nas byed pa'ang 'gal ba med de/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi skabs su khams kyi dag pa rgyas par dran pa dang / bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor la sogs rjes thob tu bshad cing mnyam bzhag tu'ang bya bar gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /yang rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor ram rjes thob tu bsdu pa'i tshe ni khrus kyi rnal 'byor gyi khongs su bsdu dgos te/ phyi dang nang gi chus khrus bya/ zhes gsungs pa'i nang gi khrus de 'di yin pa'i phyir ro/ /ces gsungs so/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas la/

rnam gzhag spyir bstan pa dang / nyams len bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ bla ma gong mas thun mtshams kyi nyes pa 'dag pa la/ dam tshig rdo rje'i bsgom bzlas dang / rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas gnyis gsungs kyang / 'dir phyi ma mdzad pa ni/ slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas/ gal te ltung sogs byung gyur na/ /yi ge brgya pas byin gyis brlabs/ /ji srid du las ma 'das par/ /dag pa'i las la nyer gnas bya/ /'gyod byas nyes pa 'phel mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa dang mthun no/ /de ji ltar bya ba yang / a bhi dha na'i le'u nyi shu rtsa lnga par/ yig brgya lha thams cad kyi sngags yin tshul/ yig brgya'i sngags dngos/ de'i 'khrul 'khor gyi phyir bzlog rnams gsungs/ le'u nyi shu rtsa drug par bshags sdom gsungs/ le'u nyi shu rtsa bzhi par 'khor lo bsgyur ba drug gi dkyil 'khor gsungs pa'i nang nas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo/ rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa yum dang bcas pa de zur du phyung nas cho ga 'di dang sbyor bar mdzad do/ /gnyis pa nyams len bye brag tu bshad pa la/ lha bsgom pa/ sngags bzla ba/ bshags sdom bya ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ bla ma kha cig rang gi snying khar rdo rje sems dpa' bsgom par 'dod la/ kha gcig rang rdo rje sems dpa' bsgom par 'dod kyang rje btsun gyis rang gi spyi bor bsgom par bshad pa ni/ a bhi dha na las/ phyi dang nang gi chus khrus bya/ zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs pa'o/ /ji ltar bsgom pa'i tshul ni/ rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du/ skad gcig gis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dpal he ru ka mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ sku mdog dkar po zhes sogs dkyus bzhin no/ /gnyis pa sngags bzla pa la/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa/ bzla bya'i sngags/ ji tsam bzlas pa'i grangs dang gsum/ dang po ni/ zhes gsol ba btab pas hūm̐ las bdud rtsi babs/

he ru ka'i sku gang / de nas dbyibs brgyud/ yum gyi sku gang zhes sogs mngon rtogs nang gi bsam bya bzhin bya'o/ /a bhi dha na las/ rnal 'byor ma yi dbang yang bskur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs pa'o/ /gnyis pa bzla bya'i sngags ni/ spyir yi ge brgya pa la du ma yod kyang / 'di ni a bhi dha nar bshad pa'i he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa yin la/ de bshad na/ oṃ ni bkra shis pa la sogs pa'i don brgyad la 'jug kyang 'dir ni mchog gi dngos grub ster ba'i don to/ /badz+ra he ru ka ni rdo rje khrag 'thung / sa ma ya ni/ dam tshig ma nu pā la ya rjes su skyongs shig ces pa ste/ rnam thar sgo gsum gyi stong pa'i rang bzhin he ru kas bdag skyongs shig ces so/ /tshul ji ltar skyong na/ he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha ni khrag 'thung gis nye bar mnos pa ste rang gi bsam pa bzhin du'o/ /dri ḍho me bha wa/ bdag la brtan pa'i rang bzhin du'o/ /su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ bdag la dga' ba'i rang bzhin du'o/ /a nu rak+to me bha wa ni bdag la chags pa'i rang bzhin du'o/ /su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ bdag la mdzes pa'i rang bzhin du'o/ /sarba sid+dhim+me pra ya ts+tsha bdag la dngos grub thams cad stsol/ sarba karma su tsa me/ bdag la las thams cad stsol ces te/ tshul de lta bu'i sgo nas bdag la rjes su skyongs shig ces pa'i don to/ /bskyangs nas ci byed ce na/ tsit+taṃ shrī yaḥku ru/ bdag gi snying la gnas par mdzod/ gang gnas par mdzod na/ hūm̐ ni chos kyi dbyings mi 'gyur ba'i gnas dang / ha bzhi ni ye shes gzhan bzhi/ ho dbyer med pa ste/ mdor na dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med pa'i nges don gyi he ru ka de/ bdag gi snying la gnas par mdzod cig pa'o/ /don de la ji skad bya na bha ga wān badz+ra he ru ka bcom ldan 'das rdo rje khrag 'thung zhes bya'o/ /des bdag nam yang spang bar bya ba ma yin pas/ mā me muñtsa bdag ma btang zhig go

/he ru ko bha wa mahā sa ma ya satwa/ khrag 'thung gi rang bzhin dam tshig sems dpa' zhes bos nas khyod kyis bdag dus thams cad du ma btang zhig ces pa'o/ /a ni gdod ma nas ma skyes pa'i phyir/ chos thams cad kyi sgo yin pas lha dang sngags dang / sgrub pa po rnams rang bzhin skye med du rgyas 'debs pa'o/ /hūm̐ ni don lnga la 'jug kyang / 'dir sdug bsngal 'chos shing 'joms byed dang / /srid pa'i zhags pa 'joms par byed/ /ces pa ltar spang bya de dag 'joms pa'i don to/ /phaṭ ni don gsum la 'jug pa las/ 'di ni sdug bsngal 'joms pa'i don du bzung ngo / /de lta bu'i gsang sngags de ni/ a bhi dha nar/ dpa' bo dang ni mkha' 'gro ma/ /'di ni kun gyi gsang sngags te/ /zhes thams cad kyi gsang sngags su bshad do/ /gsum pa ji tsam bzlas pa'i grangs ni/ slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas/ ye ge brgya pa cho ga bzhin/ /nyi shu rtsa ni re re bzlas/ /ltung sogs byin gyis brlabs 'gyur bas/ /'phel ba ru ni mi 'gyur zhes/ /grub pa mchog rnams kyis bshad pas/ /thun mtshams su ni spyad par bya/ /'bum phrag dag ni bzlas gyur na/ /rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ thun mtshams kyi nyes pa phra mo 'dag pa la/ yi ge brgya pa ma mtha' nyer gcig yan ci nus su bzlas par bya ba yin no/ /gsum pa bshags sdom bya ba ni/ mjug tu/ a bhi dha na las/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang drug gsungs pa'i mjug tu/ bla chen 'phags pas/ sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar bya'o/ /de ltar sngon 'gro gsum byas pa'i dgos pa ni/ slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas/ sdom gsum cho ga rab tu brtag /de ltar sngags pa tshul ldan pas/ /dngos grub la ni dogs med de/ /ston pa sangs rgyas sogs bstod cing / /lha sogs 'jig rten kun gyis bkur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/

/gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro gsum bshad pa la/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag pa/ ye shes kyi tshogs bsag pa/ srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ yul dag pa la brten nas tshogs bsag yul ma dag pa la brten nas tshogs bsag zhar byung dgos pa bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ tshogs zhing spyan drangs pa/ de la mchod pa 'bul ba/ de'i spyan sngar yan lag bdun pa bya ba/ gnang ba nod pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ rang 'og nas 'byung ba'i zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug par bsam pa'i snying khar/ paṃ las pad+ma dang / raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil gyi steng du sems gzung 'dzin gnyis dang bral ba'i ngo bo hūm̐ sngon po bsgom mo/ /hūm̐ de gzung 'dzin gnyis dang bral ba'i yid du ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ ha'i sgra las drangs pas gra ha ka ni gzung ba/ gra ha tsa ni 'dzin pa/ zhabs kyu u las rkyen sha byin pas/ shū n+ya tā te stong pa/ klad kor ma ni ma no ste yid do/ /de ltar na/ gzung 'dzin gnyis kyis stong pa'i yid ces par 'gyur ro/ /de las 'od zer kha dog sna lnga pa/ rlung phyir rgyu ba'i dus na sna bug g.yas nas spros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la/ bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pas dbur brgyan pa/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags dang phyag rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod pas spyan 'dren no/ /rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags dang phyag rgya ni/ gur 'grel las/ rdo rje se gol sbyor ba yis/ zhes bya ba ni/ lag pa gnyis dpung mgor rdo rje bcing ba byas la/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes brjod cing / mdzub mo lcags kyu ltar bkug nas/ mthe bong dang gung mos se gol gdab par bya'o/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ gnyis pa ni/ thog mar na mo gu ru bh+yaḥs bla ma dang / na ma shrī he badz+ra maṇ+ḍal bh+yaḥs dkyil 'khor la phyag bya'o/ /de nas mchod pa la/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pa ni/ rang gi snying kha nas mchod pa'i lha mo rnams mchod rdzas de dang de 'dzin pa sprul te/

dkar mo ste gau rīs/ ri dwags te zla ba'i brdas bstan pa'i byang sems dkar pos gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa dang / chom rkun mas/ bdud las rgyal ba ste/ nyi ma'i dpes bstan pa'i byang sems dmar pos gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa dang / ro langs mas chu lag ma ste/ dri chus gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa dang / ghasma rīs sman 'dzin pa ste/ dri chen gyis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa dang / puk+ka sīs rdo rje'i lag ste/ sha chen gyis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa ste 'di lnga ni nang gi mchod pa'o/ /de bzhin du ri khrod mas ro sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa dang / gdol pa mos cang te'u brdungs ba'i tshul gyis mchod pa ste 'di gnyis ni phyi'i mchod pa'o/ /g.yung mos nub byang gi grwa nas lha thams cad la 'khyud pa'i tshul gyis mchod nas/ lha thams cad zag med kyi bde bas tshim par bsam pa ste/ 'di ni gsang ba'i mchod pa'o/ /gsum pa ni dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ zhes pa ni/ sdig pa bshags pa'i rten gyi stobs te sngar spyan drangs pa'i tshogs zhing ngo / /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /zhes pa ni/ sdig pa rang gis byas pa dang / gzhan byed du bcug pa dang / gzhan gyis byas pa la rjes su yid rangs byas pa rnams stobs bzhi tshang pa'i sgo nas bshags pa ste sdig pa bshags pa'i yan lag go /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yid rangs/ /zhes pa ni so so skye bo nas sangs rgyas kyi bar gyi dge ba la dga' zhing phrag dog med par rjes su yid rangs ba'i yan lag go /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /zhes pa ni/ don dam sems bskyed yid kyis dam bca'i tshul du bzung ba'i yan lag go /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis ni skyabs su 'gro ba'i yan lag go /rang gzhan don ni zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis ni smon pa sems bskyed pa'i yan lag go /byang chub mchog gi zhes sogs rkang pa gsum ni 'jug pa sems bskyed pa'i yan lag go

/'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /zhes pa ni bsngo ba'i yan lag go /'o na rje btsun gyis dga' ston springs yig las/ skabs 'dir rigs lnga'i sdom bzung yang bya bar gsungs pas de yan lag bdun po gang gi nang du 'du zhe na/ 'jug pa sems bskyed rgyas par len pa yin pas de'i nang du 'du'o/ /bzhi pa gnang ba nod pa ni/ tshogs zhing gi zhal nas/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis dngos grub myur du 'grub pa'i skal ba yod kyis lam rim pa gnyis sgoms shig ces gsungs par bsam mo/ /de nas tshogs kyi zhing gshegs su gsol ba'am/ rang la bsdu ba'am/ mi dmigs pa gang rung bya'o/ /gnyis pa yul ma dag pa la brten nas tshogs bsag pa ni/ tshad med bzhi bsgom pa ste/ 'di la phar phyin theg pa ltar bsgom pa dang / gsang sngags ltar bsgom pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ don dran bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig ces sogs brjod/ gnyis pa ni rang gi snying kha nas lha mo puk+ka sī'am/ 'od zer sngon po dpag tu med pa spros te/ sems can thams cad byams pa tshad med pa la bkod pa'i mos pa byed/ rang gi snying kha nas sha ba rī'am 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa spros nas sems can thams cad snying rje tshad med pa la bkod pa'i mos pa byed/ rang gi snying kha nas lha mo gdol pa mo'am 'od zer sngon po dpag tu med pa spros nas/ sems can thams cad dga' ba tshad med pa la bkod pa'i mos pa byed/ rang gi snying kha nas lha mo g.yung mo'am 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa dpag tu med pa spros nas/ sems can thams cad btang snyoms tshad med pa la bkod pa'i mos pa byed do/ /gsum pa zhar byung dgos pa bshad pa ni/ rje btsun rtse mos/ de ltar tshogs bsag byas pa la/ /dgos pa rnam pa gnyis gsungs te/ rgyud dag pa yi dgos pa dang / /sngon gyi rgyal dang mtshungs bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/

/ skabs 'dir 'tsho byad chos skyong dpal bzang pos/ chos rje glo bo mkhan chen la zhus pa'i dri ba dris lan las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ dri ba gsum pa ye shes tshogs bsag la rje sa chen gyis snang med du gsungs shing / rnam bshad zla zer du ye shes tshogs bsag gis stong par sbyangs nas stong nyid de nyid lha'i tshul du bsgom dgos pa'i phyir zhes gsungs nas/ dzñan a ka ra'i lung drangs nas/ chos dbyings stong pa nyid las lha 'byung bar gsungs shing / spyod rgyud spyi rnam du yang de ltar bshad nas/ de ltar na stong nyid lhar bsgom par song zhing / rang gi lus lhar bsgom par ma song zhes dogs pa bkod pa dang / tshogs zhing bstims pas rkyen byas nas rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i lus dkyil bsgom pa dang / rang bzhin rgyu la bsam na lhun grub ste/ /zhes sogs ji ltar 'chad lags zhes pa'i lan ni/ legs par bshad par bya ste/ de kho na nyid kyi ngo bo ni spros pa thams cad las 'das zhing / gang du'ang bsgom par bya ba ma yin te/ yod pa dang / med pa dang / gnyis ka dang / gnyis ka ma yin pa la sogs pa gang du'ang 'phags pa rnams kyis ma gzigs shing / da lta so so skye bo'i blos de kho na nyid kyi don 'di 'dra zhig go zhes rlom tshod kyis 'chad pa'i skabs su yang yod med las 'das par 'chad dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /de bas na gnas lugs kyi ngo bo gtan la 'bebs pa'i gnas skabs su'ang de yod par bzung nas lhar bsgom zhes smra ba ni dmigs med dmigs par byas shing / lta sgom gyi shan ma phyed pas bstan chos sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba'i dgag bya'i gtso bo yin te/ dgongs gcig rtsa 'grel du 'bri khung pa'i grub mtha' la kun btags/ gzhan dbang yongs grub gsum gyi nang nas yong grub don dam pa'i bden pa kho na lhar bsgom bya dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying por byas nas de yod pa dang /

bsngo rgyu'i dge bar yang khas blangs pa la zhib tu dgag pa brjod pa'i mthar/ gang dag dmigs pa med pa yi/ /chos kyi dbyings la'ang yod pa yi/ /dge ba yin ces dmigs byed pa/ /de yi chos can gzhan dag la'ang / /dmigs par 'gyur ba smos ci dgos/ /zhes gsungs la/ theg pa rim pa dgu la lta ba tha dad du 'dod pa 'gog pa'i skabs su lta ba zhes bya ba ni yul dngos po'i gnas lugs la sgro 'dogs chod pa'i thos bsam gyi blo dang / 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag yul dang bcas pa'i bar yin zhing / blo ngo de dag la ltos na stong nyid ces bya ba yod pa tsam du'ang mi 'dod na lhar bsgom pa lta ga la zhig 'on kyang kun rdzob gyi snang ba sgyu ma lta bu 'di rnal 'byor gyi rgyud man chad la thabs la mkhas pa'i khyad par ma gtogs lhar mi bsgom zhing sgyu ma lta bu tsam zhig tu bsgom pa dang / rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud du/ kun rdzob ji ltar snang ba 'di/ /sbyang gzhi sbyong byed legs sprod pa/ /de tshe dam pa rigs brgya la/ sogs pa'i dbye ba rgyal bas gsungs/ /zhes pa'i tshul gyis snang ba'i 'khor lo thams cad lhar gsal btab ste sgom dgos rgyu yin pa la/ lta ba'i ngos nas lha dang lha ma yin pa gang du yang mi blta zhing / bsgom pa'i ngos nas lhar bsgom dgos pa'i shan ma phyed par kun rdzob lha ru blta zhes khas blangs ba la skyon brjod pa'i skabs su/ des na kun rdzob ldog pa dang / /lta ba'i ldog pa ma phyed pas/ /gsang sngags snying ma'i kun rdzob kun/ /lta ba dang 'khrul de ltar yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'dir gzhung kha gcig las/ lha'i zhes tshig ma dag par 'byung ba ni/ tshig rkang phyi ma'i lta ba zhes pa'i tshig gis gsal lo/ /de ltar na lta ba'i ldog pa ces pa ni spros pa dang bral ba don dam pa'i cha yin la/ kun rdzob kyi ldog pa ni snang ba'i cha yin pas/ spros pa dang bral ba'i cha nas lhar mi bsgom gyis/

snang ba'i cha nas lhar bsgom dgos pa yin te/ ji skad du rdo rje dra ba'i rgyud las/ kun rdzob gzugs su rnam par gnas nas ni/ /'khor lo'i gzugs kyi chos rnams rnam par brtag /ces gsungs so/ /des na bod 'dir snga phyi mang po zhig mang po zhig gis stong nyid kyi ldog pa nas lhar sgom pa'i shes byed du/ shu n+ya tās rten dang brten par bcas pa stong par sbyangs te lhar bskyed pa dang / rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgom zhes pa'i rang bzhin gyi don stong nyid la byed pa dang / chos nyid kyi gzugs dang stong gzugs la sogs pa chos nyid rang du khas len pa la sogs pa chal chol smra ba mang du byung mod/ de dag thams cad kyis ni stong nyid kyi ngang las lha la sogs pa bskyed pa dang / de nyid lhar bskyed pa'i shan ma phyed ba ste/ ye shes tshogs bsag gi rjes su lha bsgom pa thams cad stong pa nyid kyi ngang las lha bsgom par song zhing / stong pa nyid lhar bsgom pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /spyod rgyud spyi rnam las kyang / 'o na stong pa nyid lhar bsgom par song gi rang gi lus lhar bsgom par ma song zhe na/ stong pa nyid lhar su zhig gis bsgom smros shig ces gsungs la/ de'i don rang nyid kyis stong pa nyid lhar bsgom zhes smras na/ stong pa nyid kyi don de la rang nyid kyang yod pa ma yin na de rang gis lhar ji ltar bsgom zhes dgag pa byas pa yin pa'i phyir dang / rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor la sogs pa bshad pa ni rdul mtshon la sogs pa bcos ma la ltos nas tshegs chung bas rang bzhin du bshad pa yin pa'i phyir dang / stong gzugs la sogs pa bshad pa thams cad kyang stong nyid kyi don la sgro 'dogs chod cing / 'od gsal ba'i gnas thob pa rnams kyis snang ba'i dngos po thams cad kyang rnam pa de dang der snang bzhin du rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin dang dbyer mi phyed par rtogs pa la rtsa pa'i rgyud las/

nga las 'gro ba thams cad 'byung / /zhes dang / rlom sems med pa'i lhan cig skyes ba sna tshogs nyid/ /ces sogs mang du gsungs pa dang / 'khor lo bde mchog las lhan skyes kyi byin rlabs kyis sngags skyes dang / zhing skyes kyi snang ba 'char ba las sogs pa mtha' dag don gcig tu 'du ba'i phyir ro/ /yang / rang bzhin rgyu la bsam na lhun grub ste/ /zhes pa'i skabs kyi lhun grub dang / gzhung mang po las/ de kho na nyid la gdod ma nas grub ces sogs ming btags pa rnams kyang dang po nas grub pa'am/ yod pa zhig la zer ba ni ma yin te/ mya ngan 'das pa dang / 'khor ba gnyis ka'ang sngon gyi mtha' mi dmigs pa'i phyir/ des na sems kyi rang bzhin la 'pho 'gyur med pa la lhun grub ces sogs btags so/ /ci ste don dam spros bral kyi ldog pa nas lhar bsgom na sgom pa gong 'phel du mi 'gyur na lhar bsgom pa don med cing / 'gyur na rang bzhin spros bral gyi ldog pa nas gnas gyur kyang khas len dgos pas/ rang bzhin rgyu la bsam na lhun grub ste/ mtha' yas yon tan tshogs ni gnas gyur yin/ /zhes rang bzhin la ltos nas gnas gyur med pa dang / yon tan la ltos nas gnas gyur yod par bshad pa'i grub mtha'i rtsa ba 'jig par ji ltar mi 'gyur/ yod ye 'di lta bu'i grub pa'i mtha' mi zad pa rnams kyi rnam par rtog pa'i spros pas/ ci zhig tu rung ste/ yang dag ji bzhin yongs shes pas/ /bdag la phan par 'dod pa rnams/ /lta ngan nad dri ngan gos ba'i/ /bsgrags pa'i tshig la brten mi byed/ /ces bya bar shes par bya'o/ /zhes 'byung ba yin no/ /gnyis pa ye shes tshogs bsag la/ stong nyid btsan thabs su bsgom pa dang / bshig ste bsgom pa gnyis las/ 'dir btsan thabs su bsgom pa ni/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ de'ang oṃ ni 'di/ shū n+ya tā stong pa/ dzñā na ye shes/

badz+ra rdo rje/ swa bha wa rang bzhin/ at+ma ko haṃ ni nga ste/ stong pa nyid ye shes rdo rje'i rang bzhin nga'o snyam du nga rgyal 'dzin pa'o/ /ye shes tshogs bsag gi dgos pa ni/ rje btsun rtse mos/ ye shes tshogs bsag dgos pa yang / /rnam pa bzhi ru shes bya ste/ /kun tu brtags pa'i dri ma las/ /dag par bya ba'i dgos pa dang / /gnyis pa thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /lha yi smyu gu bskyed pa dang / /gsum pa bsod nams tshogs dang ni/ /ye shes tshogs su 'brel phyir dang / /bzhi pa chos kyi sku las ni/ /gzugs sku 'grub par bya phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gsum pa srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa la/ thun mong pa'i srung 'khor bsgom pa dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor bsgom pa gnyis/ dang po ni rtsa rgyud las/ re phas nyi ma sngon du rnam bsgoms nas/ /nyi der hūm̐ byung sna tshogs rdo rje ste/ /rdo rje de nyid kyis ni rā ba dang / /gur bcing ba yang rnam par bsgom pa nyid/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang / re pas te/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng tu hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ rwa nyi shu pa'am/ bcu gnyis pa/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi rdo rje phra mo nas 'bras tsam gyi thang gdal ba'am/ yang na rdo rje lam bu gcig tu gyur pa/ 'khor yug tu rdo rje'i rā ba dang / rdo rje'i 'greng bu zlum pos bskor ba/ de'i steng du rdo rje mchur rgyugs dang / yang de'i steng du rdo rje 'greng bu dang / mchur rgyugs brtsegs pa'i rwa ba dang / rwa ba'i nang du/ de dang mnyam pa'i rdo rje'i gur/ logs nyis rim du yod cing / rtse mo gur stabs su yod pa'o/ /bcing ba ni/ de'i phyi rol du ye shes kyi me ri kha dog lnga pas bcings bas ste g.yogs par byas pa'o/

/de ltar bsgoms pa'i rjes su/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā zhes lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor la/ rnam gzhag spyir bstan pa dang / nyams len bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ bshad rgyud las ji ltar gsungs pa'i tshul/ de rtsa rgyud kyi bskyed chog la sbyar mi sbyar dpyad ba/ thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor gyi sgra don dang gsum/ dang po ni/ gur le'u bcu gnyis par/ bdag med ma'i sngon 'gror/ nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus gnas par/ /sna tshogs rdo rje bsgom par bya/ /hūm̐ ni bcu yi sbyor ba yis/ /khro bo bcu ni rim pas dgod/ /gshin rje mthar byed shes rab mthar/ /pad+ma mthar byed bgegs mthar byed/ /ṭa ki khro bo dbyug pa sngon/ /mi g.yo ba dang stobs chen dang / /gtsug tor gdugs ni dkar po dang / /rdo rje zhabs 'og gnas pa ni/ /bdud rtsi sbyor bas thams cad du/ /khro bo'i sgom pas bsgom par bya/ /dpag tshad brgya ni khyab pa ru/ /bsams nas bgegs ni bskrad par bya/ /zhes khro bo bcu'i ming tsam gsungs la/ le'u bcu bzhi par/ khro bo bcu'i phyag mtshan sku mdog rigs bdag gdan/ srung 'khor gyi tshad rnams gsungs te/ le'u gnyis po 'di phyogs gcig tu byas nas 'khor lo yongs rdzogs kyi srungs 'khor bstan no/ /gnyis pa ni/ thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor 'di rtsa rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor rnams la sbyar na phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag yin gyi/ ma sbyar kyang cho ga chad pa'i skyon med la/ gur gyi dkyil 'khor rnams la nges par sbyar dgos so/ /gsum pa ni/ gur las/ de nas rdo rje 'dzin rgyal ni/ thams cad dbugs dbyung rab stsol pas/ /dam tshig rdo rje bsrung don du/ /sbas pa'i spyod yul 'di gsungs pa/ /zhes khro bo bcu'i srung 'khor sbas te gsungs par bshad la/ gang du sbas na kyai rdo rje'i rtsa rgyud du sbas pa'o/

/des na rtsa rgyud du gsungs pa'i rwa gur sogs la thun mong ba dang / bshad rgyud du gsungs pa'i khro bo bcu'i srung 'khor la thun mong ma yin par 'jog go /gnyis pa nyams len bye brag tu bshad pa ni/ ḍoṃ bhi pas rang bsrung ba'i srung 'khor dang / gnod pa phyir bzlog gi srung 'khor dang gnyis sa chen gyis yang de bzhin du gsung pas/ de ltar du bshad na rang bsrung ba'i srung 'khor dang gnod pa phyir bzlog gi srung 'khor gnyis/ su gsungs shing dang po la/ rten bskyed pa dang / brten pa bskyed pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar/ ḍoṃ bhi pas/ paṃ las pad+ma dang / raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bh+rūṃ las 'khor lo ser po/ skabs 'di'i dogs sel 'tsho byed chos skyong bzang po la/ glo bo mkhan chen gyis gnang ba'i dris lan las 'di ltar 'byung te/ dri pa bzhi pa bsrung 'khor gyi skabs su/ 'khor zhing mi g.yo pa la rnam bshad zla zer du gnyis med rdo rje dang / ba reg pa gnyis kyi lung drangs mod/ gnyis med myur du 'khor zhing gzhan du mi g.yo ba zhes pas/ bsgom pa'i gnas der 'khor zhing / gzhan phan tshun yas mar mi 'pho bar 'bru gnon na bde ba'am nyams lags/ zhes pa'i lan ni/ 'khor shing rab tu mi g.yo zhes pa'i 'bru gnon lugs khyed rang gis bzhed pa ltar bshad pas shin tu chog cing 'grig par yong ba lags/ ces 'byung ba yin no/ /rtsibs bcu pa zhes gsungs shing / de'i steng du sa chen gyis rtse mo rno ba/ khog pa stong pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ brtan zhing go skabs med pa/ zhes gsungs pa'i don/ rtsibs bcu ni steng 'og phyogs mtshams kyi rtsibs so/ /rtse mo rno ba ni rtsibs rnams ral gri so gnyis pa'i rnam pa can/ rtsa ba nas bye phrar song ba'i rtse mo shin tu rno ba'o/ /khog pa stong pa ni/ rtsibs kyi nang / sbubs stong du yod pa'o/

/yangs shing rgya che ba ni/ gur las/ dpag tshad brgya'i tshad tsam mo/ /zhes gsungs pa ni mtshon pa ste/ rnal 'byor pas blos 'khyud tshad du bsgom pa'o/ /brtan zhing go skabs med pa ni/ 'khor lo myur du 'khor ba'o/ /de nas oṃ badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa hūm̐ sogs lan gsum gyis brtan par bya'o/ /de lta bu'i 'khor lo'i nang gi dbus dang phyogs bcur pad+ma dang / nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re bsam mo/ /brten pa bskyed pa ni/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de rnams kyi steng du/ hūm̐ re re/ de yang lho'i dkar po/ nub kyi dmar po/ steng gi ser po/ gzhan thams cad sngon po/ de rnams so so'i gnas su yongs su gyur pa ni/ dbus su rang nyid hūm̐ mdzad sngon po rdo rje 'dzin pa/ shar du gshin rje zhes sogs nas steng du gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba ser po 'khor lo 'dzin pa 'og tu gnod mdzes sngon po gtun shing 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang g.yas pa rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa thugs khar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ steng dang phyogs bzhi'i khro bo rnams ni brjid pa'i khro bo zhes sogs nas/ rigs bdag gis rgyas 'debs pa'i bar ngag 'don bzhin/ de nas sngags mi bzla bar/ khro bo dang srung ba'i 'khor lo las me 'od dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ rnal 'byor sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad dpag tshad dang rgyang grags su bskrad par bsam pa ste/ mi thub zla bas/ dpag tshad brgyar ni 'jug pa yis/ /bgegs rnams bskrad par bsam par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sogs lan gsum gyis brtan par byas nas/ dbus su rang nyid hūm̐ mdzad zhu ba las/ e las zhes sogs sbrel lo/ /gnyis pa gnod pa phyir bzlog gi srung 'khor ni/ byings snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ mi 'dra ba'i gnad rnam pa lnga yod de/ dbus su rang nyid gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur bar bsgom zhing /

steng du hūm̐ mdzad bsgom pa ni/ gtso bo 'pho ba'i gnad dang / rang gi snying khar nyi ma'i steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje'i lte ba'i nang du/ rang gi rnam shes hūm̐ du bsam la de'i mthar/ bsrung bya'i ming gi yi ge dang po klad kor gyis brgyan pa bsams te/ bsrung bar bsam pa ni/ bsrung bya sba ba'i gnad dang / gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur bas hūm̐ zhes brjod pas/ phyogs mtshams kyi khro bo rnams zhal phyir gzigs thugs kha nas rang 'dra'i khro bo dpag tu med pa spros te/ pha rol gyi srung ma dang / bdag la rbad pa'i gnod byed rnams tshar gcad par bsam pa lha'i rnam pa'i gnad dang / 'khor lo g.yon du 'khor bas dgra bgegs rnams phye mar brlag par bsam pa 'khor lo 'khor ba'i gnad dang / uṣ+ṇī ṣa'i/ sngags bzla ba sngags kyi gnad do/ bsrung bya sba ba sogs kyi dmigs pa zhib par ni mngon rtogs kyi nang du blta bar bya'o/ /sngags don ni/ na maḥsaman+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/ zhes pa ni kun nas dwang bas sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'o/ /de bzhin du na maḥsaman+ta dharmā nāṃ/ kun nas dang bas chos la phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa'o/ /na maḥsaman+ta sam̐ghā nāṃ/ kun nas dang bas dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa'o/ /oṃ ni 'dir/ skal bzang rnam pa dang ldan zhing / zhes pa'i don no/ sitā ta pa tra ni gdugs dkar po can te ji ltar gdugs kyis tsha gdung skyob pa ltar/ chos dbyings ye shes kyis nyon mongs pa'i gdung ba skyob pa'i don to/ /oṃ bi ma la ni dri ma med pa ste/ chos dbyings ye shes kyi ngo bo nyon mongs pa dang mtshan ma'i dri ma dang bral ba'o/ /oṃ sham̐ ka ra ni 'byung gnas te/ ye shes de nyid chos kyi longs spyod kyi bde ba'i 'byung gnas su gyur pa'o/ /oṃ pra t+yam̐ gi ra badz+ra ni tshul ma yin pa brlag par byed pa'i rdo rje te/ ye shes des mtshan ma dang rnam par rtog pa thams cad brlag par byed pa'o/

/uṣ+ṇā+-i ṣa tsakra lbarti ni gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba ste/ sngar gyi dri ma med pa la sogs pa'i chos gsum dang ldan pa'i chos dbyings ye shes de nyid gzugs rnam khro bo gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur bar shar zhes pa'o/ /khro bo des byed las ci zhig byed na/ sarba thams cad/ yan+t+ra 'khrul 'khor/ man+t+ra sngags/ mū la karmā/ rtsa ba'i las/ ban+dhā naṃ 'ching ba/ tā ḍa ni bzlog pa ste/ mdor na sngags dang / 'khrul 'khor dang / mngon spyod kyi 'phrin las kyi sgo nas bdag la gnod pa'i las thams cad 'ching ba dang / bzlog pa'i las byed ces pa'o/ /der ma zad byed las gnyis pa ni/ kī la nām bā phur bu/ ma ma bdag la/ kri ta byas na/ ye na gal te/ ke na byed na/ tsit+ta sems kyi/ kṛ tan+ta ta de dag ste/ mdor na gzhan 'ga' zhig gis bdag la phur bu ste byad ka'i gnod pa byas pa dang / byed par sems pa de dag ces pa'o/ /sarban+tu ni thams cad ste sngar gyi gnod pa'i las thams cad phyogs gcig tu sdom nas 'joms zhes pa'o/ /ji ltar 'joms na/ tshin+dha tshin+dha gtubs shig pa ste gzhan gyi rigs sngags gtubs shig pa'o/ /bin+dha bin+dha phug gcig pa ste/ gzhan gyi phyag rgya thams cad phug cig pa'o/ /tsi ri tsi ri ni phye mar gyis shig pa ste/ rtsa ba'i las thams cad phye mar gyis shig pa'o/ /gi ri gi ri gyis shig pa ste/ gang gyis shig na/ ma ra ma ra gsod gsod ste/ gsod par gyis shig pa'o/ /don ni phyi rol gyi dgra bsad pas lus mi snang bar byas pa bzhin du chos dbyings ye shes kyis gzung 'dzin gyi bdud thams cad mi snang bar gyis shig pa'o/ /hūm̐ bcu ni chos kyi dbyings la yul dang yul can bcu med pa'i phyir hūm̐ bcu smos pa'o/ /phaṭ gsum ni dgas pa ste/ gnas gsum du ltung ba'i nyes pa rnams dgas pa'i don te/ don de dag dang ldan pa'i gsang sngags lan bdun nam nyer gcig gam/ brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa ci rigs par bzlas shing /

de'i tshe dmigs pa ji ltar bya na/ na maḥs man+ta nas tsakra brti yan chad kyis gtso bo gsal gdab/ sarba yan+t+ra nas ma ra yan chad kyis khro bo rnams las khro bo rang 'dra dpag tu med pa spros la gnod byed thams cad tshar bcad par bsam mo/ /hūm̐ bcu yis khro bo bcu gsal gdab/ phaṭ gcig gis steng gi khro bo/ phaṭ gcig gis 'og gi khro bo/ phaṭ gcig gis rang dang bsrung bya rnams gsal gdab/ de nas 'phro 'jog pa na rje sa chen gyis/ gang dag bdag la ldang ba'i zhes pa nas/ des sgrub pa'i lha 'dres de nyid kyi sha bza' bar gyur cig ces pa'i bar brjod cing thal mo brdab bo/ /de'i dmigs pa yang / lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar zla ba/ g.yon pa'i mthil du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar nyi ma/ sor mo rnams kyang rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bsam la/ lag pa gnyis thal mo brdab pa'i bar du gnod byed rtsir bas/ nyi mas bsregs zla bas gsos rnam shes mi bskyod pa'i zhing du skyes par bsam pa ste/ rdo rje gur las/ hūm̐ gis grogs byas phyag rgyas gdab/ /rdo rje 'tshir bas 'tshir ba nyid/ /ces gsungs pa'i don no/ /de nas khro bo 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis zhes sogs brjod cing / oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa sogs lan gsum gyis brtan par bya'o/ /de'i rjes su dbus su rang nyid gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba'i lte ba yangs pa'i nang du'am/ de zhu ba las e las chos kyi 'byung gnas zhes sogs sbrel lo/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ bskyed rim yan lag drug bsgom pa/ de de bzhin gshegs pa rigs drug dang sbyar ba/ de'i rgyu mtshan/ de bsgoms pa las byung ba'i rtags dang bzhi/ dang po la/ gzhal yas khang bskyed pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi yan lag rjes su chags pa rdo rje sems dpa'i yan lag dbang bskur ba mi bskyod pa'i yan lag bdud rtsi myang ba 'od dpag med kyi yan lag mchod pa don yod grub pa'i yan lag

bstod pa rin chen 'byung ldan gyi yan lag dang drug dang po la gzhi'i yan lag rgyu'i yan lag rkyen gyi yan lag gnas thabs kyi yan lag dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ skabs 'di'i dogs sel ga zi rin chen dpal la kun mkhyen rin po ches gnang ba'i dris lan las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ dri ba gnyis pa gzhal yas khang gi 'og gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje thun mong pa'i srung 'khor gyi sna tshogs rdo rje yin pa la srung 'khor thun mong ba ltar na chos 'byung dang thun mong ma yin pa dang gnyis ka ltar na chos 'byung srung 'khor 'og gi khro bo sogs chod byed yod pa ltar snang bas/ bsgom don la ji ltar lags zhes pa'i don ni/ thun mong ba'i srung 'khor gyi nang du chos 'byung sogs med par gzhal yas khang bsgom pa rnams la de gnyis gcig pa yin gyi/ gzhan rnams la de ltar ma nges te/ thun mong ba'i srung 'khor gyi nang du thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor dang de'i dbus kyi khro bo zhu ba'am/ lto ba'i nang du chos 'byung bskyed nas de'i nang du gzhal yas khang bsgom pa'i tshe gzhal yas khang gar yod pa de nyid du 'og gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas te grub pa yin gyi/ ma gi'i sna tshogs rdo rje lto ba'i nang du yar len pa yang ma yin/ lto ba'am chos 'byung thun mong ba'i srung 'khor gyi phyir rol du song ba yang ma yin no/ gdan gyi sna tshogs rdo rje du ma yod pa blo la mi shong ba yang mi dgos te/ dgra nag tu gzhal yas khang gi nang du lha'i gdan la yang sna tshogs rdo rje bshad pa bzhin no/ /gzhan du na dbus su dkyil 'khor lnga la khro bo gzhan rnams dang ldan pa'o zhes pa'i don/ dbus kyi khro bo'i lto bar gur rigs bsdus kyi dkyil khor lnga bsgom nas de'i phyi rol du khro bo bcu po dang ldan par gsungs ba'i don yang ji ltar 'chad/ des na gsang sngags rgyud sde las bshad pa'i rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad la longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'am/

sprul pa mchog gi dkyil 'khor la dngos su grub pa dang / de'i rnam pa rnal 'byor pas bdag bskyed dang / mdun bskyed gyi blo snang la bsgom pa dang de'i dmigs pa gsal ba'i ched du blos slong dang / ras bris dang / rdul mtshon sogs la bris pa ste gsum las/ dang po la me ris yan chad kyi rten dang / dur khrod kyi phyogs skyong zhing skyong yan chad kyi brten pa thams cad ye shes kyi snang ba kho na dang / gnyis pa la rnal 'byor pa'i blo snang dang / gsum pa la rdo shing dang tshon sogs las lag pa'i 'du byed kyis bzos pa yin pas blos slong la bzhengs ji tsam thub pa ye shes gyi snang ba dang blo snang la sbyar ga la nyan/ 'khor gyi lha la 'jig rten pa'i gzugs 'dzin pa dang / 'jig rten pa'i ming gis btags pa thams cad 'jig rten pa yin ces smra bar ga la rung ste/ sngar gyi gsum po gang yin dpyad pas gsal lo/ /zhes 'byung ba yin no/ da lta'i kun mkhyen bka' 'bum nang 'di sngags 'chang rat+na shrī'i dris lan du gsal lo/ /thun mong srung 'khor rkyang pa bsgom na/ de'i dbus su e las chos 'byung zhes dang / khro bo bcu'i srung 'khor bsgom na/ dbus kyi khro bo'i lto ba yangs pa'am de zhu ba las e las chos kyi 'byung gnas zhes bsgoms te/ de la chos 'byung de'i dbyibs ni/ grub chen dpal 'dzin gyis/ phyag rgya gru gsum pa nyid de/ 'dod pa dang / gzugs dang / gzugs med pa rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ 'og tu zur gcig dang / steng du gnyis pa'o zhes bshad cing / rje btsun rtse mos/ sku gsung thugs snying po'i phyir gru gsum zur bzhi pa'o/ /zhes bshad la gnyis ka don gcig te/ snga ma ni phyogs gang nas bltas kyang zur gnyis las mi mngon pa'i dbang du byas la/ phyi ma ni zur srid tshad grangs nges pa'i dbang du byas pas so/ /kha dog ni/ mtsho skyes kyi shes rab a'i rnam pa dkar por bsgom zhes dkar por bshad cing rje btsun sku mched kyi phyi dkar la nang dmar ba zhes gsungs so/
