phyi nang gi chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma grub par shes pa'i stong pa nyid dang / de nyid gzugs kyi rnam pa lha'i sku sgyu ma lta bur shar ba gnyis dbyer med pa'i rang bzhin du bsgom pa yin te/ grub chen mtsho skyes kyis/ lha'i lus kyi gnas par bya'o/ /zhes pa ni sgyu ma lta bu gnyis su med pa bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin gyi bdag nyid kyis chos thams cad lhag par mos te thams cad du gnas par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ rang gi lhag pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor dang / lha so so'i rnal 'byor ro/ /dang po ni/ ci dang cir snang ba'i dngos po thams cad kyai rdo rjer shes par byas nas longs spyod pa ste/ gsang 'dus las/ 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad ni/ /ci ltar 'dod pas bsten bya ste/ /rang gi lha yi sbyor ba yis/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod par bya/ /sogs so/ /'di ni nyung ngu la mos pa rnams kyi tha mal gyi rnam rtog bzlog pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni yul dang yul can gyi dbye ba mtha' yas par byas la/ de dag re re'ang lha so sor shes par byed pa ste/ de'ang gzugs gau rī/ sgra tsau rī/ dri bai tā lī/ ro ghasma rī/ reg sa spyod ma/ chos khams mkha' spyod ma ste phyi'i yul drug lha mo drug dang / mig sogs nang gi dbang po drug dang / rnam shes drug po gti mug rdo rje ma la sogs pa'i lha mo drug tu byas te/ lha la lha thim pa'i tshul gyis longs spyod/ 'di ni rgya chen po la dga' ba rnams tha mal par 'dzin pa dang / ril po gcig tu 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog thams cad bshig pa yin no/ /de ltar na 'ching ba'i rgyu ni tha mal pa'i rnam par rtog pa yin la/ de lha'i rnam par shes pa na/ tha mal pa dag pas thams cad ril gyis spong bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang skabs 'ga' zhig tu dkyil 'khor dang / lha'i rnam dag dang / de kho na nyid rnams kyang rgyas par dran par bya zhing / dkyil 'khor dang /

rab gnas dang / sbyin sreg dang / chos 'chad pa dang nyan pa la sogs pa'i spyod lam thams cad kyang lha'i rnal 'byor gyis bya'o/ /bcu pa rjes chags kyi rnal 'byor ni/ khyim pa rdo rje 'dzin pas/ las kyi phyag rgya bsten par 'dod na/ lha'i 'du shes/ sngags kyi 'du shes/ chos kyi 'du shes te bya ba de gsum dang ldan pas bsten na 'dod chags nyid byang chub kyi lam du 'gyur ro/ /de la lha'i 'du shes ni rang kyai rdo rje dang / yum bdag med mar bskyed pa'o/ /sngags kyi 'du shes yum gyi mkha'/ stong par bsam pa'i ngang las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u 'bru la ās mtshan par bskyed la/ pad+ma su kha sogs kyis byin gyis brlabs/ yab kyi gsang gnas stong par bsam pa'i ngang las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan par bskyed la/ oṃ badz+ra mahā sogs kyis byin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas gnyis ka'i mgor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ bsam mo/ /chos kyi 'du shes ni bskyed pa'i rim pa ltar na bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyis dpal kyai rdo rje la mchod par bsam mo/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa ltar na lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du bya'o/ /zhes bsam mo/ /rgyas par ni dbang gsum pa'i man ngag tu rtogs par bya'o/ /'di'i dgos pa gsum te/ 'dod pas log par g.yem par mi 'gyur pa dang / lha mchod par 'gyur pa dang / lhan skyes kyi ye shes rtogs par 'gyur ba'o/ /dang po ni/ de nyid 'dus par/ 'dod chags lta bu'i bde ba med/ /de bas rgyal ba rnams la 'bul/ /sems can don phyir gzhan bud med/ /bsten pas bsod nams thob par 'gyur/ /zhes pa ste/ chos kyi 'du shes kyi dgos pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni rdo rje gur las/ rang nyid he ru kar byas shing / /rang gi btsun mo ngar byas nas/ /chags chen gyis ni 'dod spyod pa/ /de la nga ni rtag tu mnyes/ /zhes pa ste lha'i 'du shes kyi dgos pa'o/

/gsum pa ni/ slob dpon in+d+ra bhū tis/ bde ba bde ba chen po kun/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal gcod byed cing / /mya ngan 'das pa'i gnas thob ces/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad gsungs/ /zhes gsungs par ltar ro/ /'di ni rnal 'byor pa khyim pa kho na'i dbang du mdzad nas gsungs kyi/ dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa la ni 'di mi dgos pas/ rnal 'byor dgus nyin mtshan 'khor yug tu 'da' bar byed pa yin no/ /rnal 'byor bcu la bshad pa'i go rim/ mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor gnyis/ mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor brgyad/ ces pa 'di bde ba yin na yang / 'di ni mdang nub mo nyal ba'i rnal 'byor nas brtsams te/ nyin zhag gcig gi nyams len gyi rim pa'i dbang du byas nas bshad pa yin no/ /bdun pa sbyang gzhi sbyong zhing lam byed bzhis lam du byed pa'i tshul la gnyis te/ sbyang gzhi sbyong pa'i tshul dang / de nyid lam byed bzhis lam du byed pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la/ tha mal gyi rnam rtog sbyong ba'i tshe bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa/gya nom lhar zhen pa spong pa'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa'o/ /de la bskyed pa'i rim pas tha mal gyi rnam rtog sbyong pa yang / rdo rje gur gyi le'u bcu bzhi pa las/ phal pa'i gnas skabs gzhom pa'i phyir/ /bsgom pa yang dag rab tu grags/ /rang bzhin gnas skabs bsgoms pa las/ /bsgom pa ma yin mi bsgom min/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rtog pa de bzhin te/ /'on kyang mi gtsang ba'i tshad mnyam par sbyong ba'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs rab tu bsgom par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la mi gtsang ba'i tshad tha mal pa'i rnam rtog la gnyis/ rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa dang / 'bras bu bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa'o/ /dang po sbyong ba ni tshogs gnyis bsags pa yin la/ gnyis pa bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa ni snod bcud gnyis te/ de'ang snod sbyong ba ni/

'byung ba bzhi las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa dang / yang dpa' bo gcig pa'i dbang du byas na gdan no/ bcud sbyong ba la gnyis/ skyed chog gis skye gnas bzhi sbyong ba'i tshul dang / lha'i rnam pas dug gsum sbyong ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ 'khor bar skye ba'i gnas skye gnas bzhi yin la/ de sbyong ba skyed chog bzhi yin te/ de yang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo gcig la sbyar na mngon byang lnga las rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa bskyed pa'i nyi ma drod/ zla ba gsher/ drod gsher gnyis las skyes pa'am/ nyi zla gnyis kyis khu khrag gnyis mtshon pas mngal skyes kyi blo sbyong ba'o/ 'khor rnams mngal nas 'byin pas mngal skyes sbyong ba'o/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa thig le'i gong bu las bzhengs pas sgong skyes sbyong / skye mched kyi lha skad gcig ma'am/ sa bon tsam las bskyed pas brdzus skyes kyi blo sbyong ngo / /de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu bas ni snod bcud 'jig pa sbyong ngo / /gzhan yang ā li las zla bas nyon mongs pa gti mug gzugs kyi phung po/ kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa sbyong / de bzhin du kā li las nyi mas nyon mongs pa nga rgyal dang ser sna/ tshor ba'i phung po/ nyon mongs pa can gyi yid sbyong / bar gyi phyag mtshan sa bon gyis mtshan pas nyon mongs pa 'dod chags/ 'du shes kyi phung po/ yid kyi rnam shes sbyong / nyi zla phyag mtshan dang bcas pa ro gcig tu 'dres pas nyon mongs pa phrag dog 'du byed kyi phung po sgo lnga'i rnam shes sbyong / sku yongs su rdzogs pas/ nyon mongs pa zhe sdang / rnam par shes pa'i phung po/ chos can nyon mongs pa lnga dang / phung po lnga'i chos nyid sbyong / de ltar na sbyang gzhi sbyong ba'i bskyed pa'i rim pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba yin no/ /gnyis pa lha'i rnam pas dug gsum sbyong pa ni/ khro bo'i skur bzhugs pas zhe sdang 'dul/ btsun mo'i 'khor gyi dbus na bzhugs pas 'dod chags sbyong /

mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa'i skur bzhugs pas gti mug zhi bar byed pa yin no/ de ltar na khro chags kyi skus rtsa ba'i nyon mongs pa gsum zhi bar byed pas nyon mongs pa gzhan rnams shugs la zhi bar byed pa yin no/ /gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rim pas gya nom lhar zhen pa sbyong bar byed de/ /brtag pa gnyis pa'i le'u gnyis pa las/ bskyed pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor gyi/ /brtul zhugs can gyis spros pa bsgom/ /spros pa rmi lam ltar byas nas/ /spros pa nyid ni spros med byed/ /ces gsungs so/ /gzhan yang rdzogs pa'i rim pas sbyang gzhi tha mal pa mtha' dag gi bden zhen sbyong ste/ saṃ bu ṭa brtag pa bcu pa las/ rnam rtog gti mug chen po ste/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed yin/ /mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas na/ /mkha' bzhin dri ma med par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /de ltar na sbyang gzhi rim pa gnyis kyis sbyong tshul ni/ bskyed pas kun rtog sbyong la/ de nyid rdzogs pas sbyong ba dang / skye ba bskyed pas sbyong la/ 'chi ba rdzogs pas sbyong ba dang / bskyed rdzogs re res kyang skye ba dang 'chi ba'am/ snang ba dang stong pa'am/ rtog pa mtha' dag sbyong ba yin te/ de lta bu'i sbyong tshul so so ba rnams ni ngag las brtsal bar bya'o/ /de ltar skye 'chi la sogs pa sbyongs ba/ sbyangs gzhi dang sbyongs byed thams cad ngo sprod pa lam thams cad gcig tu bsres nas ston pa 'di ni rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po birawa pa'i bshad pa yin no/ /gnyis pa thob bya sku gnyis yin pas rim pa gnyis bsgom pa'i 'thad pa ni/ bskyed pa'i rim pas gzugs kyi sku thob par byed pa yin la/ rdzogs pa'i rim pas chos kyi sku thob par byed do/ /dang po'ang gur gyi le'u dang po las/ de phyir dkyil 'khor 'khor lo zhes/ /thabs ni bde ba'i sdom pa ste/ /sangs rgyas nga rgyal rnal 'byor gyis/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni 'grub par 'gyur/

/ston pa sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan/ /gtso bo dpe byad brgyad cur ldan/ /de ni thabs kyi gzugs can no/ /zhes gsungs pas/ 'bras bu dang mthun pas sbyang bar bya ba'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs bsgom pa'i dbang du byas na/ gong du bstan pa de dag de bzhin gshegs pa mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas pa dang mthun te/ tshogs gnyis bsags pas ni/ bskal ba grangs med pa gsum du tshogs bsags pa dang 'dra/ srung ba'i 'khor los srod la bdud btul ba/ gzhal yas khang gis ma dag pa'i snod sbyangs te/ 'og min du byin gyis brlabs/ mngon par byang chub pa lnga'i rim pas lha'i rnam par grub pa ni/ 'og min nam rdo rje gdan du tho rangs sangs rgyas pa dang 'dra/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por mngon par dbang bskur bas 'od zer gyi spro bsdus sems can gyi don byed pa dang / bzlas pa la sogs pa chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang mthun/ bskyed pa'i rim pa bsdus te stong pa nyid du bsgoms pas yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa dang mthun te/ de ltar mdzad pa bcu gnyis dang mthun pa sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las mdzad nas/ slar yang mdzad pa rgyun mi 'chad pa dang 'dra bar stong pa nyid kyi ngang las lha'i skur langs nas/ spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor gyi tshul gyis sems can gyi don byed pa yin no/ /des na bskyed pa'i rnam pas sangs rgyas kyi gzugs kyi sku 'grub par byed pa dang mthun pas 'bras bu lam du byed pa zhes kyang bya'o/ /gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rim pas chos kyi sku thob par byed de/ saṃ bu ṭa'i brtag pa drug pa las/ rang byung ngo bo nyid 'di ni/ /chos kyi skur ni rab tu grags/ /zhes gsungs/ gur le'u drug pa las/ chos kyi dbyings ni 'od gsal ba/ /gang zhig bsgom pa de bas ni/ /sems can sangs rgyas mnyam par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu ste/ rdzogs rim gyi nyams gzung 'jug ngo bo nyid dang mthun pa rnams/

chos sku dang mthun par mos shing bsres la lam du bya'o/ /de lta bu'i rim pa gnyis bsgoms pas 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sku gnyis 'grub pa de'ang lan gcig de lta bu'i rnam pa 'grub pa la da lta nas de lta bu bsgoms pas 'bras bu lam du byed pa zhes bya ba yin no/ /gsum pa rang gi ngo bo rten dang brten pa yin pa'i 'thad pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i rim pas bskyed rim kyang sbyong ba'i phyir dang / 'bras bu chos kyi sku 'grub pa yin na de nyid kyis chog pas bskyed rim don med do zhe na/ de'i lan ni/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa de ltar bzang yang de la rten bskyed pa'i rim pa med na/ rdzogs rim nyid kyang mi 'byung ste/ rdzogs rim ni bskyed rim la brten pa yin pas/ rten dang brten pa 'bral ba med do zhes bya'i don to/ /gnyis pa de nyid lam byed bzhis lam du byed pa'i tshul ni/ sngar bshad pa'i sbyang gzhi dang / sbyong byed de dag thams cad kyang 'dra chos dang mtshon don rtog pa rang dga' bas bsgrigs pa tsam ma yin gyi/ sems kun gzhi'i steng du mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad kyi bag chags gnas pa'i stobs kyis/ kun rdzob kyi snang ba thams cad 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sa'i gzugs sku dang / chos sku'i rnam pa rang bzhin rnam dag gi tshul gyis 'byung ba yin par ni rtsa brgyud phyi ma'i bcu gcig par lus can thams cad kha dog dang dbyibs kyi sgo nas rigs lngar nges tshul gsungs pas shes la/ de'i phyir bsgoms pas glo bur gyi dri ma dag ste mngon tu 'gyur ba ni sbyang gzhi dang sbyong byed mtshon don bsgrigs pa'i don no/ /des na 'di la sbyang gzhi thams cad lam gyi rnam pa de dang der bsgom pa'i tshul dang / de nyid lam byed bzhis byin gyis brlab pa'i tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni sngar rgyas par bshad zin cing / mtshan gzhi gcig la sbyar na/ mngal skyes kyi ma'i phyag rgya gru gsum dang /

sgong skyes kyi sgo nga sogs bzhi po ma dag pa'i phyag rgya sogs ma yin gyi/ bdag gi blo la snang ba'i chos 'byung gru gsum 'di yin no snyam du dbyer med du bsgom mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ de ltar chos 'byung gru gsum bsgoms pas rnam pa gzugs kyi rnam par bsgom sla bas rnam pa lam du byed pa zhes bya/ de nyid rnam thar sgo gsum dang / spyan ma la sogs pa'i phyag rgyar mos pa byas pas mos pa lam du byed pa zhes bya/ de yang sangs rgyas sa'i 'bras bu rnam thar sgo gsum dang / spyan ma la sogs pa'i phyag rgya dngos yin par bsgoms pas/ 'bras bu lam du byed pa zhes bya/ des rnal 'byor pa'i sems rgyud byin gyis brlabs shing tshogs rdzogs pas byin rlabs lam du byed pa zhes bya ste/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang zhen pas 'jug cing 'brel bas mi bslu ba'i lam yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de la zhen pas 'jug pa ni sbyang gzhi la rnam par zhen/ rnam pa la 'bras bu dngos su zhen pa'o/ /'brel pas mi bslu ba ni sbyang gzhi dang / lam dang 'bras bu gsum char yang gcig la gcig 'brel ba'am/ don la dbyer med pas mi bslu ba ste/ bskyed pa'i rim pas sbyang gzhi dang sbyong byed bsgoms pas sangs rgyas sa'i chos thams cad thob pa'i rgyu mtshan yang 'di nyid yin no/ /de ltar rnal 'byor bcu po sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyar zhing lam byed bzhi ldan du brtson pa drag pos bsgoms pas drod chung ngu thob pa na/ kun 'dar gsang nas spyod/ des drod 'bring po thob pa na kun 'dar 'jig rten pa'i mngon du spyod/ des lung bstan pa'i bu mo pad+ma can bsten nas drod chen po thob pa na/ kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa zla ba gcig gis sa brgyad pa thob ste/ nye rgyu spyod pa'i skal ba dang ldan par 'gyur zhing / de nas nye rgyu zhag bdun gyis/ rdo rje 'chang chen po sa bcu gsum pa thob par 'gyur ba ni nges pa'o/

/zhes dpal kyai rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa'i rnam par bshad pa 'jam dbyangs dgongs rgyan zhes bya pa 'di ni/ sa bcu'i byang sems chen po bud+dha rat+na'i rnam par sprul pa rgyal ba mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi gsung rgyun yid bzhin gyi nor bu rnams gzhir bzhag cung zad dran gso dgos pa rnams/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rnam bshad snying po don gsal ji lta ba bzhin la legs bshad kyi cha 'ga' zhig bsnan te/ shrī sa skya pa shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos me pho 'brug gi lo snron gyi zla ba'i dga' ba gnyis pa'i tshes la dpal sa skya'i bla brang phun tshogs gling gi thos bsam 'brug sgra tshal gyi rang byung bsam gtan khang bur bris pa'o/ 'di sbyar dge bas dang por rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bar du rje btsun bud+dha rat+na'i mtshan/ /da lta bstan pa'i nyi ma mus pa rje/ /sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan skal brgyar zhabs brtan shog /tshul 'di zab gnad kun gyi bcud bsdus te/ /gzhung lugs rgya mtsho sgo brgya'i lde mig yin/ /de phyir dpyod ldan rnams kyis le lo'i bdud/ /ring du spongs la tshul 'di blang bar rigs/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i bdag po sa skya pa'i/ /dri med bstan pa spel mdzad srol mang yang / /rab gsal blo yis legs par dpyod shes na/ /phyogs 'dzin rmongs pa'i dmod tshig mi dgos kyi/ /phal cher dri med gzhung dang 'gal ba med/ 'on kyang rung mthun lung dang bshad khungs lung / /so sor phye nas dgag sgrub mdzad pa rnams/ /dmod tshig 'dra yang bstan pa'i gsal byed yin/ /'on kyang rnam bshad 'di ni dgag sgrub rnams/ /btang snyoms bzhag ste bsgom don gtso bor bshad/ /rgya cher shes par 'dod na gong ma yi/ /gsung rab rnams la 'bad de len par gyis/ /snyigs ma'i dus kyi sems can bsod nams dman/ /don med tshe 'di'i bya bas dus kun 'da'/

/dam pa'i spyod tshul 'dzin pa re re tsam/ /de phyir zas gtsang sras kyi bstan pa 'di/ /kye ma da ni mtshan gyi lhag mar nye/ /des na deng dus spyod ldan 'ga' yod na/ /sngon byon gong ma'i rnam thar legs skyongs shig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// //gcig zhus// yang zhus// ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 80 a myes zhabs/ kye rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa'i rnam bshad zin bris 'jam dbyangs dgongs rgya/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 79
